meta.title: Source Formalization Pipeline Documents
meta.description: DDD documentation framework for Source Formalization projects — the governed translation layer that turns human-readable sources (PDF standards, policies, regulations, procedures, API documentation, web content) into typed, traceable, validated knowledge artifacts through a 9-stage pipeline (Acquire + Use Authorization Gate → Extract → Segment → Semantic Extract → Normalize → Provenance Consolidation + Authority → Validate → [Conditional] Organizational Contextualization → Publish) before any RAG, context formalization or agent runtime consumes them. AI reads this file and generates .md files in the correct order with proper cross-references.
meta.applicable_when: Building a pipeline whose product is a governed, published set of knowledge artifacts derived from external or internal source documents — with per-operation use authorization, cross-stage provenance, source-fidelity validation and a publication manifest. Distinct from the ai-chatbot template's KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md (which starts from already-usable content and owns chunking, embedding and retrieval) and from the ai-workflow template (a scheduled LLM task pipeline with no source-rights, provenance or publication gate). Use this template when the questions are 'what is this source, may we process it this way, and can every derived claim be traced back to it' — not 'how do we retrieve or answer'.

agent_instructions.role: You are a source-formalization documentation generator. Read this file and produce each document listed in phases[], in dependency order.
agent_instructions.generation_order_strategy: Topological sort by depends_on graph. Generate documents with no dependencies first. Each document is the canonical source for its concerns — downstream docs reference upstream docs by document ID. Contract enums are defined once in their owner document and only indexed in GLOSSARY.md.
agent_instructions.content_language: Write document content in Thai for narrative sections; use English for all identifiers, code, contract names, schema_version strings, enum values, field names and technical terms. Preserve jargon (source record, acquired representation, segment, semantic artifact, provenance, lineage, authority, applicability, interpretation, use authorization, trust boundary, manifest, supersede, verbatim, normalized, evidence span, hash, licence) as English even in Thai sentences.
agent_instructions.quality_gate: Each document must cover all sections[] listed. Validate that cross-references (refs[]) resolve to real document IDs before finishing. Every contract, enum, governance rule, pipeline stage and source must be documented exactly once in its canonical doc and referenced elsewhere — no duplicate definitions. Never hardcode real company or product names — use placeholders or the fictional organization so the template stays reusable. Never present a page, clause, publisher, date or licence term that the source material does not support. A value that needs calibration, or that the source material does not yet supply, is written as null together with the role who will supply it — never as a plausible-looking default — and the missing / null / unknown / not_applicable distinction GLOSSARY.md owns is applied exactly, so every null is a stated decision with an owner, not an omission.
domain_specific_notes: Source Formalization ≠ RAG ingestion. This pipeline ends at a governed, published knowledge artifact plus a handoff record; chunking, embedding, retrieval and context assembly are downstream consumers reached only through PUBLICATION_SPEC.md — never fold them into stage documents.
Segment ≠ retrieval chunk. SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md defines semantic/source boundaries; retrieval representations are derived later and must link back to segment_id.

Authority ≠ relevance ≠ confidence ≠ applicability ≠ freshness ≠ truth. PROVENANCE_MODEL.md keeps authority descriptive (publisher_type, document_class, source_status, jurisdiction) — no single authority or trust score.

Stage 8 is a branch, not a mandatory stage. CONTEXTUALIZATION_SPEC.md owns the typed SKIP / APPLY / NEEDS_REVIEW routing decision; SKIP publishes source-derived artifacts directly and must never smuggle organizational interpretation into source assertions.

TREAT_AS_DATA is a principle, not a boundary. TRUST_BOUNDARY.md defines the real boundary as privilege separation, tool/secret/connector isolation, schema validation and policy enforcement; external source content can never trigger tools, reveal secrets or bypass gates.

Possession ≠ authorization. USE_AUTHORIZATION.md decides per operation × purpose × target with rights and information-governance evidence; overall_status is for routing only, and one operation's ALLOW never implies another's.

Three status dimensions never collapse: validation_status (PASS/FAIL) ≠ approval_status (APPROVED) ≠ lifecycle_status (PUBLISHED). ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md owns all three enums; the publish gate requires PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS + NOT_REQUIRED or APPROVED + RELEASE_CANDIDATE.

Never invent page, clause, publisher, date, identifier or obligation. Missing ≠ null ≠ unknown ≠ not_applicable per GLOSSARY.md; unresolved cross-references stay unresolved; model-produced fields carry evidence spans or are marked UNKNOWN.

The running example uses only rights-clear publishers (NIST Technical Series public-domain material, OWASP CC BY-SA content) and a fictional organization; ISO/IEC appears only as a short NEEDS_REVIEW teaching contrast. Deterministic checks always run before any LLM judge.

description.th: เป้าหมาย: รู้ว่า source คืออะไร ใครถือสิทธิ์ ทำ operation ไหนได้กับ target ไหน และ trust boundary อยู่ตรงไหน ก่อนเขียน contract ใด ๆ
description.en: Goal: Know what each source is, who holds the rights, which operations are allowed against which targets, and where the trust boundary sits — before writing any contract.

description.th: นิยาม domain ของ source ที่จะ formalize — source families ใน scope, roles, intended operation × purpose × target, downstream consumers, boundary กับ OCR/chunking/Context Formalization และ capability tier ที่เลือก
description.en: Defines the source domain being formalized — source families in scope, roles, intended operation × purpose × target inventory, downstream consumers, the boundary with OCR/chunking/Context Formalization, and the chosen capability tier.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a SOURCE_DOMAIN.md that anchors the whole Source Formalization project. State which source families are in scope (standards, regulations, internal policies, API documentation, web content, spreadsheets) and which are explicitly out of scope, with the reason. Define every role that touches the pipeline — source owner, legal/rights reviewer, privacy officer, security governance lead, pipeline engineer, SME assessor, downstream context engineer — with the decisions each role owns. Inventory every intended operation × purpose × target combination the project will actually perform (parse, structured extraction, AI processing, publish, redistribute) so the authorization gate has a finite matrix to decide. Name the downstream consumers (Context Formalization, RAG, knowledge graph, compliance engine, audit) and what each needs from a published artifact. Draw the boundary between Source Formalization and OCR, parsing, chunking, Context Formalization, retrieval and optimization, and list what the pipeline does not guarantee (source truth, publisher correctness, relevance). Finally choose the MVP or Enterprise capability tier per capability and justify it against constraints.
agent_hints.input_context: Root document — no upstream dependencies. Derived from stakeholder interviews and the Source Formalization methodology steps 1–3 and 13 (define source domain, define intended operation/purpose/target, inventory sources, handoff downstream).
agent_hints.validation: Every source family must be marked in-scope or out-of-scope with a reason. Every role must own at least one decision. Every intended use must be a full operation × purpose × target triple. Every downstream consumer must state what it needs from a published artifact. Boundary section must list at least five nearby concepts. Capability tier must be stated per capability, not globally.

description.en: Constraints the pipeline must respect — rights/licence regime, information governance (classification, personal data, residency, AI-vendor policy), tooling/format/model limits, audit level, cost and timeline.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a CONSTRAINTS.md listing every constraint that binds the Source Formalization pipeline, each with an ID, a policy reference and the decision it constrains. Describe the rights and licence regime per source family: public-domain government works, Creative Commons variants with attribution or ShareAlike duties, purchased or subscription-licensed standards whose terms restrict AI/ML use, and organization-owned documents. Record information-governance constraints: classification levels, personal-data presence, confidentiality, access policies, data-residency and cross-border limits, and the AI-vendor/processing policy. State tooling constraints: which parsers and OCR engines are available, which model IDs may be called for which classification, and format limits. Fix the audit and assurance level the project must meet (replayability, lineage completeness, authenticity evidence). Close with cost, volume and timeline constraints: number of sources, re-ingest cadence, LLM budget and deadlines.
agent_hints.input_context: Root document — no upstream dependencies. Derived from the organization's policy inventory, licence records and tooling limits. Never assume that possessing a document authorizes AI processing or redistribution.
agent_hints.validation: Every constraint must have: id, category, policy_ref or evidence_ref, decision constrained. Rights section must cover every source family from SOURCE_DOMAIN.md. Information governance must state classification, personal data, residency and AI-vendor policy explicitly, even when the answer is 'none'. Audit level must be one named tier, not a range.

description.th: Ubiquitous language ของ Source Formalization — นิยาม term, boundary pairs ที่ห้ามปน, registry ของทุก enum ชี้ไปยัง owner doc, naming conventions และ semantics ของ missing/null/unknown/not_applicable
description.en: The Source Formalization ubiquitous language — term definitions, boundary pairs that must never be conflated, a registry of every enum pointing to its owner document, naming conventions, and missing/null/unknown/not_applicable semantics.

suggested_headings: Missing, Null, Unknown and Not-Applicable Semantics

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a GLOSSARY.md that is the naming authority for the whole project. Define every core term of the concept map — source, upstream source, acquired representation, extracted element, semantic segment, semantic artifact, normalized record, provenance, authority, validation, applicability, interpretation, publication manifest — with one agreed definition and an owner role. List the boundary pairs the team must never conflate: semantic segment vs retrieval chunk, authority vs relevance vs confidence vs applicability vs freshness vs truth, integrity vs authenticity, source assertion vs ground truth, possession vs authorization, document class vs normative status, TREAT_AS_DATA vs security boundary. Build an enumeration registry that indexes every controlled enum to the document that owns its values — do not redefine values here. Fix identifier prefixes, hash format, schema_version format and enum casing. Define the semantics of missing, null, UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE so validators can reject ambiguity. Keep a change log with downstream updates required.
agent_hints.input_context: Terms originate from the source families and roles in SOURCE_DOMAIN.md and the policy vocabulary in CONSTRAINTS.md. Enum values are defined once in their owner documents (USE_AUTHORIZATION.md, ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md, SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md, NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md, CONTEXTUALIZATION_SPEC.md, EXTRACTION_SPEC.md, SOURCE_CONTRACT.md); this glossary only indexes them.
agent_hints.validation: Every term must have exactly one definition and one owner role. Every boundary pair must state why conflating the two is harmful. Every enum in the registry must name its owner document and must not list values here. Identifier prefixes must be listed for every artifact type. Missing, null, UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE must each have a distinct definition.

description.th: นิยามเดียวที่ทุก role ยอมรับ ต่อหนึ่ง term ตาม concept map

description.th: คู่ concept ที่ห้ามปนกัน พร้อมผลเสียเมื่อปน
description.en: Concept pairs that must never be conflated, with the harm when they are.

items.text_th: Semantic Segment ≠ Retrieval Chunk — segment คือ semantic/source boundary; chunk คือ IR representation ที่สร้างทีหลังและต้อง link กลับ segment_id
items.text_en: Semantic Segment ≠ Retrieval Chunk — a segment is a semantic/source boundary; a chunk is an IR representation built later that must link back to segment_id

items.text_th: Authority ≠ Relevance ≠ Confidence ≠ Applicability ≠ Freshness ≠ Truth — authority บอกสถานะ publisher/document class เท่านั้น; document class ≠ normative status ของทุก element; source assertion ≠ ground truth
items.text_en: Authority ≠ Relevance ≠ Confidence ≠ Applicability ≠ Freshness ≠ Truth — authority describes publisher/document-class status only; document class ≠ normative status of every element; source assertion ≠ ground truth

items.text_th: Integrity ≠ Authenticity, Possession ≠ Authorization, TREAT_AS_DATA ≠ Security Boundary — hash พิสูจน์แค่ bytes ไม่เปลี่ยน, การมีไฟล์ไม่ใช่สิทธิ์, และ instruction ให้ treat เป็น data ไม่ใช่ boundary จริงตาม TRUST_BOUNDARY.md
items.text_en: Integrity ≠ Authenticity, Possession ≠ Authorization, TREAT_AS_DATA ≠ Security Boundary — a hash proves only unchanged bytes, holding a file is not a right, and an instruction to treat content as data is not a real boundary per TRUST_BOUNDARY.md

items.text_en: Envelope and Semantic Enums — validation_status, approval_status, lifecycle_status, activity_type → ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md; artifact_type, extraction_method, interpretation_status → SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md; element_type → EXTRACTION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Operational Enums — validation-report status → VALIDATION_SPEC.md; mapping_status, resolution_status → NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md; condition status → USE_AUTHORIZATION.md; executor kind → ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md; provenance_completeness_status → PROVENANCE_MODEL.md; redistribution_class → PUBLICATION_SPEC.md; source_trust / trust_classification → TRUST_BOUNDARY.md; acquisition_channel, relationship / reference_stability, modifier type → SOURCE_CONTRACT.md

sections.heading: Missing, Null, Unknown and Not-Applicable Semantics

description.th: ความหมายที่ต่างกันของ field หาย, null, UNKNOWN และ NOT_APPLICABLE
description.en: The distinct meanings of an absent field, null, UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE.

items.text_th: Four Distinct States — missing (field ไม่ปรากฏ = schema error), null (ค่าไม่มีในต้นฉบับและ schema อนุญาต), UNKNOWN (ต้นฉบับมีแต่ตัดสินไม่ได้), NOT_APPLICABLE (ไม่เกี่ยวกับ source ประเภทนี้)
items.text_en: Four Distinct States — missing (field absent = schema error), null (value absent in source and schema allows it), UNKNOWN (source has it but it cannot be determined), NOT_APPLICABLE (irrelevant to this source type)

items.text_th: No-Invention Rule — เมื่อหาค่าไม่พบให้ใช้ null หรือ UNKNOWN ตาม schema ห้ามเดา page, clause, publisher, date
items.text_en: No-Invention Rule — when a value cannot be found use null or UNKNOWN per schema; never guess page, clause, publisher, date

items.text_th: Validator Behavior — VALIDATION_SPEC.md ต้อง reject missing และตรวจว่า UNKNOWN ทำให้เกิด review routing ไม่ใช่ผ่านเงียบ ๆ; NOT_APPLICABLE ใช้ได้เฉพาะเมื่อ capability profile ใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md ประกาศไว้ล่วงหน้า และห้ามใช้เพื่อทำให้ check ที่ fail กลายเป็นเขียว
items.text_en: Validator Behavior — VALIDATION_SPEC.md must reject missing and verify UNKNOWN triggers review routing rather than passing silently; NOT_APPLICABLE is valid only where the SOURCE_CATALOG.md capability profile declared it in advance and is never used to turn a failing check green

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a SOURCE_CATALOG.md that registers every source instance the project will process. Give each source a stable source_id, title, publisher, source family and the roles responsible. For every source separate the upstream publication (canonical URI, DOI or release reference, format, reference stability) from the acquired representation actually processed (path or object ref, representation format, expected and actual content hash). Record document identity as base reference plus edition/revision plus modifiers (amendment, addendum, corrigendum, errata) and draw the version graph with supersedes/superseded_by and amended_by links; keep conflicting official metadata as alternate observations with a basis instead of reconciling silently. Capture authenticity evidence per source: acquisition channel, signature status, trusted registry reference — distinct from the integrity hash. Declare one versioned capability profile per source family (e.g. NORMATIVE_DOCUMENT/v1, API_DOCUMENTATION/v1, WEB_CONTENT/v1, SPREADSHEET_MATRIX/v1) stating for every optional capability — ocr, table_fidelity, figure_interpretation, modality_mapping, cross_reference_resolution, contextualization, authority_descriptors, publication_forms — whether it APPLIES or is NOT_APPLICABLE, with a reason and an owner; assign exactly one profile to every source and state that a source without one cannot run. Summarize rights and information-governance status per source with evidence references, pointing to the full decision matrix. Finish with descriptive authority fields per source: publisher_type, document_class, jurisdiction, document_approval_status, source_status.
agent_hints.input_context: Sources come from the in-scope families in SOURCE_DOMAIN.md; rights and governance classes come from CONSTRAINTS.md; identifier formats and the source_status enum owner come from GLOSSARY.md. This catalog holds instances only — the field contract lives in SOURCE_CONTRACT.md.
agent_hints.validation: Every source must have: source_id, publisher, source family, canonical_uri, acquired path, expected_content_hash, retrieved_at. Upstream and acquired representation must be separate rows or blocks. Every source must show base reference and modifiers (or an empty modifiers list). Authenticity evidence must be present or explicitly marked as hash-only. Every source must reference its use-authorization record and rights evidence. Authority fields must be descriptive values, never numeric scores. Every source family in scope must have a capability profile covering all eight optional capabilities with APPLIES or NOT_APPLICABLE plus a reason, and every source must name exactly one capability_profile_ref.

description.en: The Use Authorization Gate — per operation × purpose × target decisions for every source with rights and information-governance evidence, conditions and verification, review routing, and the invariants runtime must enforce before any model/tool execution.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a USE_AUTHORIZATION.md — the canonical authorization gate. Define the model: K = F(S; P) only if G_authz(S, operation, purpose, target, policy) permits, with the five-value decision enum ALLOW / CONDITIONAL / DENY / UNKNOWN / NEEDS_REVIEW and the six policy dimensions (rights/licence, confidentiality/classification, privacy/personal data, access authorization, data residency, AI vendor/processing policy). Fix the controlled vocabulary for operations, purposes and targets. Produce the decision matrix: one row per source × operation × purpose × target with the decision, conditions, and separately traceable rights and information-governance evidence refs. Specify how CONDITIONAL conditions are expressed and verified (condition, status, evidence_ref, verified_by) and that only trusted verifiers may mark SATISFIED. Specify source_use_authorization/v1.0 as a typed record — authorization_id, schema_version, source_id, policy_snapshot, evaluator, evaluated_at, expires_at, next_reevaluation_at, overall_status, an immutable decisions[] entry per triple, and a revocation block whose non-ACTIVE status makes the gate fail closed as DENY. Define review routing for NEEDS_REVIEW and UNKNOWN, the USE_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW activity, and re-evaluation triggers (licence change, new amendment, policy update). Close with the invariants: overall_status is routing-only, execution resolves the exact triple, one ALLOW never implies another, and the gate runs before any model or tool call.
agent_hints.input_context: Policy dimensions and licence duties come from CONSTRAINTS.md; every source and its rights evidence comes from SOURCE_CATALOG.md; decision and vocabulary enums are owned here and indexed by GLOSSARY.md. Every operation inventoried in SOURCE_DOMAIN.md must have a row in the matrix.
agent_hints.validation: Decision enum must have exactly five values. Every source × operation × purpose × target from the inventory must have a decision. Every non-ALLOW row must have at least one evidence_ref. Every CONDITIONAL row must list conditions and the verifier. Rights evidence and information-governance evidence must be separate fields. The source_use_authorization/v1.0 record must list every field with type, required and nullable, including the revocation block and its four status values, and must state the fail-closed rule for expired or revoked records. The invariants section must state that overall_status is never used for execution decisions.

items.text_en: Condition Vocabulary — e.g. ATTRIBUTION_PRESERVED, SHAREALIKE_LICENSE_APPLIED, MODIFICATIONS_NOTICE_PRESENT, PII_REDACTED_BEFORE_INFERENCE, TH_RESIDENT_COMPUTE, INTERNAL_ONLY

description.th: Contract ที่ทำให้ decision matrix เป็น record ที่ runtime อ่านและ validator ปฏิเสธได้จริง ไม่ใช่ตารางในเอกสาร

items.text_en: Record Shape — source_use_authorization/v1.0: authorization_id, schema_version, source_id (from SOURCE_CATALOG.md), policy_snapshot {policy_ref, policy_version, constraint_ids[]}, evaluator {kind ∈ POLICY_ENGINE / HUMAN_REVIEWER / HYBRID, name, version}, evaluated_at, expires_at (nullable), next_reevaluation_at, overall_status, decisions[], revocation — registered in the SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md contract inventory

items.text_th: Decision Entry — decisions[] แต่ละตัวคือ {decision_id, operation, purpose, target, decision, conditions[], rights_evidence_refs[], governance_evidence_refs[], decided_at, decided_by} และเป็น immutable: การเปลี่ยนคำตัดสินสร้าง record version ใหม่ + USE_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW activity ตาม ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md ห้ามแก้ค่าเดิมในที่เดิม
items.text_en: Decision Entry — each decisions[] entry is {decision_id, operation, purpose, target, decision, conditions[], rights_evidence_refs[], governance_evidence_refs[], decided_at, decided_by} and is immutable: changing a decision creates a new record version plus a USE_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW activity per ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md — never an in-place edit

items.text_th: Validity and Revocation — revocation {status ∈ ACTIVE / EXPIRED / REVOKED / SUPERSEDED, effective_from, revoked_by, reason (nullable)}; record ที่ status ≠ ACTIVE หรือเลย expires_at ต้อง fail closed — gate ปฏิบัติเหมือน DENY ไม่ใช่ UNKNOWN และ artifact ที่ publish ไปแล้วเข้า withdrawal propagation ของ PUBLICATION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Validity and Revocation — revocation {status ∈ ACTIVE / EXPIRED / REVOKED / SUPERSEDED, effective_from, revoked_by, reason (nullable)}; a record whose status is not ACTIVE or that is past expires_at must fail closed — the gate treats it as DENY, not UNKNOWN — and artifacts already published enter the PUBLICATION_SPEC.md withdrawal propagation

description.th: queue สำหรับ NEEDS_REVIEW/UNKNOWN และ trigger ที่ต้องประเมินใหม่

items.text_en: Review Queues — NEEDS_REVIEW → legal/security/privacy/governance queue; UNKNOWN → block or governed review; DENY → block that operation, per the procedure in RUNBOOK.md

items.text_th: Review Activity — ทุกการเปลี่ยน decision ต้องเป็น USE_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW activity ที่มี executor และ evidence ตาม ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md
items.text_en: Review Activity — every decision change must be a USE_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW activity with executor and evidence per ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md

items.text_en: Re-evaluation Triggers — licence change, new amendment/version, policy update, new target, classification change

description.th: กติกาที่ runtime ต้องบังคับเสมอ
description.en: Rules runtime must always enforce.

items.text_th: Exact Triple Resolution — execution ต้อง resolve decision ของ operation × purpose × target ที่แน่นอน; overall_status ใช้ routing เท่านั้น ห้ามใช้แทน decision จริง
items.text_en: Exact Triple Resolution — execution must resolve the decision for the exact operation × purpose × target; overall_status is routing-only and never substitutes for the real decision

items.text_th: No Implied Permission — ALLOW ของ operation หนึ่งไม่ imply ALLOW ของอีก operation แม้ source เดียวกัน; NEEDS_REVIEW โดยรวมไม่ยกเลิก ALLOW ที่ explicit
items.text_en: No Implied Permission — ALLOW for one operation never implies ALLOW for another on the same source; an overall NEEDS_REVIEW does not cancel an explicit ALLOW

items.text_th: Gate Before Execution — gate ต้องรันก่อน model/tool call ทุกครั้ง (assert_operation_allowed) และเป็น rule ที่ AGENTS.md บังคับ; trust boundary ใน TRUST_BOUNDARY.md ต้องพร้อมก่อน semantic processing
items.text_en: Gate Before Execution — the gate runs before every model/tool call (assert_operation_allowed), enforced as a rule in AGENTS.md; the trust boundary in TRUST_BOUNDARY.md must be in place before semantic processing

description.th: Security canon ของ pipeline — threat model ของ source content (indirect prompt injection), extractor privilege profile, sanitization path, ความต่างระหว่าง TREAT_AS_DATA กับ security boundary จริง, injection detection/routing และ security test requirements
description.en: The pipeline's security canon — threat model for source content (indirect prompt injection), extractor privilege profile, sanitization path, the difference between TREAT_AS_DATA and a real security boundary, injection detection/routing, and security test requirements.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a TRUST_BOUNDARY.md that treats every external or internal source as untrusted data. Build the threat model: indirect prompt injection arriving through files, web pages, spreadsheets or PDFs, attempts to alter system instructions, request secrets, invoke tools, change publication policy or bypass validation. Define the extractor privilege profile from the source contract's trust_boundary block — source_trust class, embedded_instruction_policy TREAT_AS_DATA, and the three booleans (side-effect tools, secrets, privileged connectors) all false by default with least-privilege, isolated credentials. Describe the safe path: Use Authorization Gate → parser/sanitizer → (redaction, for personal-data sources) → safe representation → extraction LLM or semantic processor → schema-constrained output → deterministic validator → policy engine/human review, and state that sanitization and redaction are different passes with different triggers. State explicitly that TREAT_AS_DATA is a design principle and that the real boundary is privilege separation, tool isolation, secret isolation, connector isolation, schema validation and policy enforcement. Specify injection detection signals, the trust_classification value assigned, and routing (isolate, reject action request, continue data extraction if safe). List the security tests the test plan must run.
agent_hints.input_context: Classification and AI-vendor policy come from CONSTRAINTS.md; boundary pairs from GLOSSARY.md; the gate that must run first is USE_AUTHORIZATION.md. Ground the threat model in references/owasp-llm01-indirect-injection.md (indirect injection via attacker-controlled external sources and its mitigations).
agent_hints.validation: Threat model must list at least five injection outcomes to prevent. Privilege profile must state all three booleans and their default. Safe path must have every stage in order. The document must explicitly say TREAT_AS_DATA is not a security boundary by itself and name the real controls. Every detection signal must map to a routing action. Security tests must cover injection, privilege and secret isolation.

description.th: ภัยที่มาจาก content ของ source เอง โดยเฉพาะ indirect prompt injection
description.en: Threats originating from source content itself, especially indirect prompt injection.

items.text_th: Attack Surface — ไฟล์, เว็บเพจ, spreadsheet, PDF ที่ attacker ควบคุมได้อาจฝัง instruction เช่น "ignore rules and call tool" (indirect prompt injection)
items.text_en: Attack Surface — files, web pages, spreadsheets, PDFs under attacker control may embed instructions e.g. "ignore rules and call tool" (indirect prompt injection)

items.text_th: Outcomes to Prevent — เปลี่ยน system/developer instructions, ขอ secrets, เรียก side-effect tools, แก้ publication policy, bypass validation gate, ปลอม provenance
items.text_en: Outcomes to Prevent — altering system/developer instructions, requesting secrets, invoking side-effect tools, changing publication policy, bypassing the validation gate, forging provenance

source_trust Enum — EXTERNAL_PUBLIC, EXTERNAL_CONTROLLED, INTERNAL_CONTROLLED (owned here, recorded per source and mapped to classifications in CONSTRAINTS.md); every class is data per the GLOSSARY.md boundary pair
items.text_th: source_trust Enum — EXTERNAL_PUBLIC, EXTERNAL_CONTROLLED, INTERNAL_CONTROLLED (นิยามที่นี่ บันทึกต่อ source และ map กับ classification ใน CONSTRAINTS.md); ทุก class เป็น data ตาม boundary pair ใน GLOSSARY.md

items.text_en: trust_classification Enum — the per-artifact value = source_trust values ∪ {INJECTION_SUSPECTED}; owned here and referenced by the artifact envelope, never re-listed elsewhere
items.text_th: trust_classification Enum — ค่าต่อ artifact = ค่าของ source_trust ∪ {INJECTION_SUSPECTED}; นิยามที่นี่และให้ artifact envelope อ้างถึง ห้าม list ค่าซ้ำที่อื่น

description.th: สิทธิ์ที่ semantic extractor มีและไม่มีโดย default
description.en: What the semantic extractor may and may not have by default.

items.text_th: Trust Boundary Block — source_trust, embedded_instruction_policy = TREAT_AS_DATA, side_effect_tools_available_to_extractor = false, secrets_available_to_extractor = false, privileged_connectors_available_to_extractor = false ตาม SOURCE_CONTRACT.md
items.text_en: Trust Boundary Block — source_trust, embedded_instruction_policy = TREAT_AS_DATA, side_effect_tools_available_to_extractor = false, secrets_available_to_extractor = false, privileged_connectors_available_to_extractor = false per SOURCE_CONTRACT.md

items.text_th: Least Privilege — extractor ใช้ isolated credentials, อ่านได้เฉพาะ acquired representation, เขียนได้เฉพาะ artifact store ของ stage ตัวเอง
items.text_en: Least Privilege — extractor uses isolated credentials, reads only the acquired representation, writes only to its own stage's artifact store

items.text_th: Gate Precondition — extractor เริ่มได้เมื่อ USE_AUTHORIZATION.md ให้ ALLOW หรือ CONDITIONAL ที่ satisfied สำหรับ AI_PROCESSING × purpose × target นั้น
items.text_en: Gate Precondition — the extractor may start only when USE_AUTHORIZATION.md grants ALLOW or satisfied CONDITIONAL for that AI_PROCESSING × purpose × target

description.th: ลำดับจาก gate → sanitizer → extractor → schema → validator → policy/human
description.en: The path from gate → sanitizer → extractor → schema → validator → policy/human.

items.text_th: Safe Path — Use Authorization Gate → parser/sanitizer ใน EXTRACTION_SPEC.md → safe representation → extraction LLM/semantic processor → schema-constrained output → deterministic validator → policy engine / human review → governed artifact
items.text_en: Safe Path — Use Authorization Gate → parser/sanitizer in EXTRACTION_SPEC.md → safe representation → extraction LLM/semantic processor → schema-constrained output → deterministic validator → policy engine / human review → governed artifact

items.text_th: Sanitization ≠ Redaction — sanitization ป้องกัน injection (ทำทุก source, ไม่ลบข้อความ), redaction ป้องกันการรั่วของข้อมูลส่วนบุคคล (ทำเฉพาะ source ที่ contains_personal_data, เปลี่ยนข้อความจริง); source ที่มีข้อมูลส่วนบุคคล safe path คือ Gate → parser/sanitizer → redaction ตาม EXTRACTION_SPEC.md → sanitized representation → model เท่านั้น
items.text_en: Sanitization ≠ Redaction — sanitization defends against injection (runs for every source and deletes no text); redaction prevents personal-data leakage (runs only for sources whose contains_personal_data is true and does change the text); for a personal-data source the safe path is Gate → parser/sanitizer → redaction per EXTRACTION_SPEC.md → sanitized representation → model, and no other order

items.text_th: Output Constraints — schema, allowed enum, source evidence requirement, no-invention rule, embedded instructions are data ตาม model-assisted rules ใน SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md
items.text_en: Output Constraints — schema, allowed enums, source evidence requirement, no-invention rule, embedded instructions are data, per the model-assisted rules in SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md

items.text_th: Validator Check — VALIDATION_SPEC.md ตรวจ trust_boundary_validity ว่า extractor รันภายใต้ profile จริง ไม่ใช่เชื่อ prompt
items.text_en: Validator Check — VALIDATION_SPEC.md checks trust_boundary_validity, confirming the extractor actually ran under the profile rather than trusting the prompt

description.th: TREAT_AS_DATA เป็นหลักการ ไม่ใช่ boundary; boundary จริงมาจาก isolation และ enforcement
description.en: TREAT_AS_DATA is a principle, not a boundary; the real boundary comes from isolation and enforcement.

items.text_th: Principle Layer — TREAT_AS_DATA เป็น instruction/design principle ตาม boundary pair ใน GLOSSARY.md; ลด risk แต่ไม่ enforce ด้วยตัวเอง
items.text_en: Principle Layer — TREAT_AS_DATA is an instruction/design principle per the GLOSSARY.md boundary pair; it reduces risk but enforces nothing by itself

items.text_th: Boundary Layer — privilege separation, tool isolation, secret isolation, connector isolation, schema validation, policy enforcement คือ control ที่บังคับได้จริง
items.text_en: Boundary Layer — privilege separation, tool isolation, secret isolation, connector isolation, schema validation, policy enforcement are the controls that actually enforce

items.text_th: Agent Rule — AGENTS.md ต้องห้าม pattern ที่ให้ source text เปลี่ยน instruction, ขอ secret, เรียก tool หรือ alter publication policy
items.text_en: Agent Rule — AGENTS.md must forbid patterns that let source text change instructions, request secrets, invoke tools or alter publication policy

description.th: สัญญาณตรวจจับ injection และ action ที่ตามมา
description.en: Injection detection signals and the actions that follow.

items.text_th: Detection Signals — imperative ที่สั่ง agent, คำขอ secret/tool, ข้อความอ้างเป็น system message, URL/payload ผิดบริบท ในเนื้อหา source
items.text_en: Detection Signals — imperatives addressed to the agent, secret/tool requests, text posing as a system message, out-of-context URLs/payloads inside source content

items.text_th: Trust Classification Update — artifact ที่พบสัญญาณได้ trust_classification = INJECTION_SUSPECTED (ค่านิยามไว้ใน Threat Model for Source Content ด้านบน) และ VALIDATION_SPEC.md บันทึก issue
items.text_en: Trust Classification Update — artifacts with signals get trust_classification = INJECTION_SUSPECTED (value owned in Threat Model for Source Content above) and VALIDATION_SPEC.md records an issue

items.text_th: Routing — isolate / reject action request / continue data extraction if safe ตาม failure routing ใน RUNBOOK.md; ไม่มี side effect เกิดได้เพราะ extractor ไม่มี tool
items.text_en: Routing — isolate / reject action request / continue data extraction if safe, per failure routing in RUNBOOK.md; no side effect is possible because the extractor has no tools

description.th: test ที่ต้องมีเพื่อพิสูจน์ว่า boundary ทำงานจริง

items.text_th: Injection Corpus — ชุด source ที่ฝัง injection หลายรูปแบบ; expected: extraction ยังได้ artifact ที่ถูก, ไม่มี tool call, ไม่มี secret leak
items.text_en: Injection Corpus — sources embedding varied injections; expected: extraction still yields a correct artifact, no tool call, no secret leak

items.text_th: Privilege Tests — พิสูจน์ว่า extractor ไม่มี secrets/tools/connectors จริงใน runtime (negative tests)
items.text_en: Privilege Tests — prove the extractor really has no secrets/tools/connectors at runtime (negative tests)

items.text_th: Gate Bypass Tests — source content พยายามให้ publish โดยไม่ผ่าน validation ต้องล้มเหลว; รายละเอียดใน TEST_PLAN.md
items.text_en: Gate Bypass Tests — source content attempting to publish without validation must fail; details in TEST_PLAN.md

description.th: สถาปัตยกรรม pipeline 9 stage — diagram, boundary และเจ้าของแต่ละ stage, Stage 8 เป็น branch, reference architecture services, deterministic/model/protocol layers, MVP vs Enterprise และ Key Architecture Decisions
description.en: The 9-stage pipeline architecture — diagram, stage boundaries and owners, Stage 8 as a branch, reference architecture services, deterministic/model/protocol layers, MVP vs Enterprise, and Key Architecture Decisions.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an ARCHITECTURE.md for the Source Formalization pipeline. Begin with a Mermaid diagram of the nine stages — Acquisition + Use Authorization Gate, Extraction, Segmentation, Semantic Extraction, Normalization, Provenance Consolidation + Authority, Validation, Organizational Contextualization (conditional), Publish — showing the branch after Validation into direct publish, contextualize, or review/quarantine. For each stage give its boundary question, inputs, outputs, the transformation activity it emits and the document that owns its contract. Explain why Stage 8 is a branch, not a universal requirement, and the two publication paths. Describe the reference architecture services (source registry + authz, extraction, segmentation, semantic extractor, normalization, provenance consolidation, validation gate, publish/knowledge hub). Separate the three layers: deterministic code (hashing, authz enforcement, schema validation, gates, manifest), model (semantic extraction only after the gate), and protocol (the source_formalization_protocol/v1.2 stage list with preconditions and failure routing). Present the MVP vs Enterprise table per capability. Record Key Architecture Decisions as KAD-NNN with context, decision, consequences.
agent_hints.input_context: Scope, consumers and chosen tier come from SOURCE_DOMAIN.md; budget and audit level from CONSTRAINTS.md; the gate that opens every run is USE_AUTHORIZATION.md and the privilege posture is TRUST_BOUNDARY.md. Each stage's detailed contract is owned by its stage document — this document only maps stages to owners.
agent_hints.validation: Mermaid diagram must be valid syntax and show all nine stages plus the three outlets after Validation. Every stage must have: boundary question, inputs, outputs, activity_type, owner document. Protocol must list every stage id with its precondition where one exists. MVP vs Enterprise table must cover every capability. Every KAD must have: id, context, decision, consequences, status.

items.text_en: Nine Stages — Acquire + Use Authorization Gate → Extract → Segment → Semantic Extract → Normalize → Provenance Consolidation + Authority → Validate → [Conditional] Organizational Contextualization → Publish

items.text_en: Deterministic Layer — hashing, source id/version storage, operation/purpose/target authorization enforcement, trust-boundary enforcement, parsing, schema validation, referential integrity, enum validation, span checks, version linking, publish gates, manifest generation per SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md

items.text_en: Protocol Layer — source_formalization_protocol/v1.2: stages acquire_and_authorize, extract (precondition: authorized), segment, semantic_extract (precondition: model processing authorized), normalize, govern, validate, contextualize (optional), publish, with failure routing

description.th: เป้าหมาย: เขียน contract และ boundary ของทั้ง 9 stage ให้ deterministic ตรวจได้ ก่อนเขียนโค้ดหรือ prompt
description.en: Goal: Define the contracts and boundaries of all 9 stages so they are deterministic and verifiable before writing code or prompts.

description.th: Contract กลางที่ทุก artifact ใน pipeline ต้องห่อด้วย — identity, source linkage, สาม status dimension (validation / approval / lifecycle) ที่ห้ามปนกัน, transformation activity ที่สร้าง artifact และกติกา reproducibility
description.en: The shared contract every pipeline artifact is wrapped in — identity, source linkage, three status dimensions (validation / approval / lifecycle) that never collapse, the transformation activity that produced it, and reproducibility rules.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md defining the metadata envelope shared by every artifact the pipeline produces (segments, semantic artifacts, normalized artifacts, validation reports, applicability/interpretation records, publication manifests). State why one envelope exists: without it every artifact type invents its own metadata language and validation, approval and lifecycle get mixed into one field. Document the full source_artifact_envelope/v1.2 contract field by field (artifact_id, artifact_type, artifact_version, source_id, source_segment_ids, created_by_activity_id, content_hash, created_at, validation_status, approval_status, lifecycle_status, latest_validation_report_id, use_authorization_ref, trust_classification) with type, required and nullable. Define the three status enums here as the canonical source — validation_status (NOT_RUN, PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, FAIL, REQUIRES_REVIEW), approval_status (NOT_REQUIRED, DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED), lifecycle_status (DRAFT, RELEASE_CANDIDATE, PUBLISHED, SUPERSEDED, QUARANTINED, RETIRED) — and state the separation invariant with a concrete example of an artifact that is PASS but PENDING and still RELEASE_CANDIDATE. Document the source_transformation_activity/v2.0 contract: the 14 activity_type values (REDACT is an activity inside the Acquire → Extract boundary, not a tenth stage), executor {kind, name, version}, config_hash, input/output artifact ids, started_at/completed_at. Document source_pipeline_run/v1.0 as the record one run emits: run_id, pipeline_version, protocol_version, idempotency_key and how it is derived, trigger, executor_environment, status, stage_attempts[], activity_ids[], outcome and supersedes_run_id — plus the three run rules: a COMPLETED key never publishes twice, a retry is a new attempt rather than a reused activity_id, and only one RUNNING run exists per (source_id, idempotency_key). Explain identity rules (source and derived artifacts have separate ids; versions are immutable snapshots; never overwrite). Close with the reproducibility rule: model + prompt + temperature + config may not be enough for exact replay, so the actual produced artifact is persisted with its hash.
agent_hints.input_context: Enum names and boundary pairs follow GLOSSARY.md; the envelope is referenced by every stage in the pipeline defined in ARCHITECTURE.md; use_authorization_ref points to a record defined in USE_AUTHORIZATION.md. Every downstream contract document embeds this envelope rather than redefining its fields.
agent_hints.validation: Every envelope field must state type, required and nullable. All three status enums must list every allowed value exactly once, and the separation invariant must be stated with at least one worked example. All 14 activity_type values must be listed, with REDACT marked as a conditional in-boundary activity. The source_pipeline_run/v1.0 contract must list every field with type, required and nullable, must state how idempotency_key is derived, and must make duplicate publication, resume-from-PARTIAL and concurrent-start behavior decidable. Every identity rule must be decidable (a validator could reject a violation). The reproducibility rule must name what is persisted for nondeterministic activities.

description.th: ทำไมต้องมี envelope กลาง และ artifact ชนิดใดบ้างที่ต้องใช้
description.en: Why a shared envelope exists and which artifact types must use it.

items.text_th: Problem Statement — ถ้าแต่ละ artifact ประดิษฐ์ metadata ของตัวเอง ระบบจะเทียบ status, trace lineage และ enforce publish gate ข้าม stage ไม่ได้
items.text_en: Problem Statement — if each artifact invents its own metadata, the system cannot compare status, trace lineage or enforce the publish gate across stages

items.text_th: Covered Artifact Types — segment, semantic artifact, normalized artifact, contextualization decision, applicability record และ interpretation record ใน pipeline ของ ARCHITECTURE.md ห่อด้วย envelope นี้; validation report และ publication manifest เพียงอ้างถึง envelope (latest_validation_report_id, artifacts[]) ไม่ได้ carry envelope status fields
items.text_en: Covered Artifact Types — segments, semantic artifacts, normalized artifacts, contextualization decisions, applicability records and interpretation records in the ARCHITECTURE.md pipeline carry this envelope; validation reports and publication manifests only reference it (latest_validation_report_id, artifacts[]) and do not carry envelope status fields

items.text_th: Terminology Authority — ชื่อ field และ enum ใช้ตามคำที่นิยามใน GLOSSARY.md; เอกสารนี้เป็นเจ้าของค่า enum ของสาม status dimension
items.text_en: Terminology Authority — field and enum names follow GLOSSARY.md terms; this document owns the enum values of the three status dimensions

description.th: Field ทั้งหมดของ source_artifact_envelope/v1.2 พร้อม type, required, nullable
description.en: Every field of source_artifact_envelope/v1.2 with type, required and nullable.

items.text_th: Identity Fields — artifact_id, artifact_type, artifact_version, source_id, source_segment_ids[], created_by_activity_id, content_hash, created_at (ทุกตัว required)
items.text_en: Identity Fields — artifact_id, artifact_type, artifact_version, source_id, source_segment_ids[], created_by_activity_id, content_hash, created_at (all required)

items.text_th: Status Fields — validation_status, approval_status, lifecycle_status (required) และ latest_validation_report_id (nullable) ชี้ไป report ล่าสุดโดยไม่ copy รายละเอียดเข้า artifact
items.text_en: Status Fields — validation_status, approval_status, lifecycle_status (required) and latest_validation_report_id (nullable) pointing to the latest report without copying its details into the artifact

items.text_th: Governance Fields — use_authorization_ref (required) อ้าง authorization record ใน USE_AUTHORIZATION.md และ trust_classification (required) ซึ่งค่าถูกนิยามใน TRUST_BOUNDARY.md
items.text_en: Governance Fields — use_authorization_ref (required) referencing an authorization record in USE_AUTHORIZATION.md and trust_classification (required) whose values are owned by TRUST_BOUNDARY.md

items.text_th: Schema Version — envelope ประกาศ schema_version: source_artifact_envelope/v1.2 เสมอ และ payload ของแต่ละ artifact type ต่อท้ายจาก envelope ไม่ทับ field
items.text_en: Schema Version — the envelope always declares schema_version: source_artifact_envelope/v1.2, and each artifact type's payload extends the envelope without overriding fields

description.th: สาม enum ที่เป็น canonical ของ pipeline และกติกาว่าห้ามใช้ enum เดียวแทนสาม dimension
description.en: The pipeline's three canonical status enums and the rule that one enum never stands in for three dimensions.

items.text_th: validation_status — NOT_RUN, PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, FAIL, REQUIRES_REVIEW; ผลจาก validation gate ใน VALIDATION_SPEC.md เท่านั้น
items.text_en: validation_status — NOT_RUN, PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, FAIL, REQUIRES_REVIEW; set only by the validation gate in VALIDATION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: approval_status — NOT_REQUIRED, DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED; governance approval ที่แยกจากผล validation โดยสิ้นเชิง
items.text_en: approval_status — NOT_REQUIRED, DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED; governance approval fully separate from validation results

items.text_th: lifecycle_status — DRAFT, RELEASE_CANDIDATE, PUBLISHED, SUPERSEDED, QUARANTINED, RETIRED; transition RELEASE_CANDIDATE → PUBLISHED เกิดโดย publish gate ใน PUBLICATION_SPEC.md เท่านั้น
items.text_en: lifecycle_status — DRAFT, RELEASE_CANDIDATE, PUBLISHED, SUPERSEDED, QUARANTINED, RETIRED; the RELEASE_CANDIDATE → PUBLISHED transition happens only through the publish gate in PUBLICATION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Separation Invariant — artifact อาจ PASS แต่ยัง PENDING approval และ lifecycle ยัง RELEASE_CANDIDATE พร้อมกันได้; ห้ามใช้ APPROVED หรือ VALIDATED แทน PUBLISHED ตาม boundary pair ใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Separation Invariant — an artifact may be PASS, still PENDING approval and still RELEASE_CANDIDATE at once; APPROVED or VALIDATED never stands in for PUBLISHED, per the GLOSSARY.md boundary pair

description.th: Contract ของ activity ที่สร้าง artifact — source_transformation_activity/v2.0
description.en: The contract for the activity that produced an artifact — source_transformation_activity/v2.0.

items.text_th: Activity Types — ACQUIRE, USE_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW, REDACT, EXTRACT, SEGMENT, SEMANTIC_EXTRACT, NORMALIZE, PROVENANCE_CONSOLIDATE, VALIDATE, CONTEXTUALIZATION_DECIDE, ASSESS_APPLICABILITY, INTERPRET, ORGANIZATIONAL_MAP, PUBLISH — หนึ่งค่าต่อหนึ่ง stage ใน ARCHITECTURE.md ยกเว้น REDACT ที่เป็น activity ภายในช่วง Acquire → Extract (ไม่ใช่ stage ที่สิบ) และรันเฉพาะ source ที่ contains_personal_data = true ตาม EXTRACTION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Activity Types — ACQUIRE, USE_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW, REDACT, EXTRACT, SEGMENT, SEMANTIC_EXTRACT, NORMALIZE, PROVENANCE_CONSOLIDATE, VALIDATE, CONTEXTUALIZATION_DECIDE, ASSESS_APPLICABILITY, INTERPRET, ORGANIZATIONAL_MAP, PUBLISH — one value per stage in ARCHITECTURE.md, except REDACT which is an activity inside the Acquire → Extract boundary (not a tenth stage) and runs only for sources whose contains_personal_data is true per EXTRACTION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Activity Fields — activity_id, run_id, activity_type, input_artifact_ids[], executor {kind, name, version}, config_hash (nullable), output_artifact_ids[], started_at, completed_at
items.text_en: Activity Fields — activity_id, run_id, activity_type, input_artifact_ids[], executor {kind, name, version}, config_hash (nullable), output_artifact_ids[], started_at, completed_at

items.text_th: Executor Kinds — HUMAN, SOFTWARE_AGENT, MODEL_SERVICE เช่น {kind: MODEL_SERVICE, name: <pinned-model-id>} สำหรับ SEMANTIC_EXTRACT; activity เหล่านี้คือ lineage event ที่ PROVENANCE_MODEL.md นำไป consolidate
items.text_en: Executor Kinds — HUMAN, SOFTWARE_AGENT, MODEL_SERVICE e.g. {kind: MODEL_SERVICE, name: <pinned-model-id>} for SEMANTIC_EXTRACT; these activities are the lineage events PROVENANCE_MODEL.md consolidates

description.th: Record ของการรัน pipeline หนึ่งครั้ง — idempotency, retry, การกู้คืนกลางทาง และการกัน publish ซ้ำ
description.en: The record of one pipeline run — idempotency, retries, mid-pipeline recovery and duplicate-publication prevention.

items.text_th: Run Record — source_pipeline_run/v1.0: run_id, schema_version, source_id, pipeline_version, protocol_version (ค่า source_formalization_protocol/v1.2 จาก ARCHITECTURE.md), idempotency_key, trigger {kind ∈ SCHEDULED / MANUAL / SOURCE_CHANGE / REPROCESS, actor, reason}, executor_environment {build_ref, runtime_version, region}, started_at, completed_at (nullable), status ∈ RUNNING / COMPLETED / PARTIAL / FAILED / ABANDONED, stage_attempts[], activity_ids[], outcome {publication_id (nullable), quarantined_artifact_ids[], review_queue_refs[]}, supersedes_run_id (nullable) — ทุก transformation activity ของ run นี้ถือ run_id เดียวกัน
items.text_en: Run Record — source_pipeline_run/v1.0: run_id, schema_version, source_id, pipeline_version, protocol_version (the source_formalization_protocol/v1.2 string from ARCHITECTURE.md), idempotency_key, trigger {kind ∈ SCHEDULED / MANUAL / SOURCE_CHANGE / REPROCESS, actor, reason}, executor_environment {build_ref, runtime_version, region}, started_at, completed_at (nullable), status ∈ RUNNING / COMPLETED / PARTIAL / FAILED / ABANDONED, stage_attempts[], activity_ids[], outcome {publication_id (nullable), quarantined_artifact_ids[], review_queue_refs[]}, supersedes_run_id (nullable) — every transformation activity of this run carries the same run_id

items.text_th: Idempotency and Duplicate Prevention — idempotency_key คำนวณแบบ deterministic จาก source_id + acquired_representation.actual_content_hash (SOURCE_CONTRACT.md) + pipeline_version + ชุด config_hash ของทุก stage + prompt version จาก PROMPT_SPEC.md + version ของ authorization record; run ใหม่ที่ key ซ้ำกับ run ที่ COMPLETED และมี publication_id แล้ว ห้าม publish อีก — reprocess ที่ตั้งใจต้องระบุ supersedes_run_id และสร้าง artifact version ใหม่ ไม่ใช่ publication ที่สองของ input เดิม
items.text_en: Idempotency and Duplicate Prevention — idempotency_key is derived deterministically from source_id + acquired_representation.actual_content_hash (SOURCE_CONTRACT.md) + pipeline_version + the set of stage config_hash values + the prompt versions from PROMPT_SPEC.md + the authorization record version; a run whose key matches a COMPLETED run that already has a publication_id must not publish again — a deliberate reprocess sets supersedes_run_id and produces new artifact versions, never a second publication of identical inputs

items.text_th: Retry, Partial Recovery and Concurrency — retry คือ entry ใหม่ใน stage_attempts[] {stage_id, attempt_no, status, activity_id (nullable), started_at, completed_at, failure_class} ห้าม reuse activity_id เดิม; resume เริ่มจาก stage สุดท้ายที่ attempt COMPLETED และ input ยัง hash ตรง; อนุญาต RUNNING ได้ run เดียวต่อ (source_id, idempotency_key) — ตัวที่สองถูกปฏิเสธ ไม่ใช่ queue เงียบ ๆ; run ที่ตายกลางทางเป็น PARTIAL และ artifact ที่เขียนค้างอยู่ที่ DRAFT หรือ QUARANTINED เท่านั้น ห้ามเป็น RELEASE_CANDIDATE
items.text_en: Retry, Partial Recovery and Concurrency — a retry is a new stage_attempts[] entry {stage_id, attempt_no, status, activity_id (nullable), started_at, completed_at, failure_class} and never reuses an activity_id; a resume starts from the last stage whose attempt is COMPLETED and whose inputs still hash-match; only one RUNNING run is allowed per (source_id, idempotency_key) — a second start is rejected, not silently queued; a run that dies mid-pipeline is PARTIAL and its half-written artifacts stay DRAFT or QUARANTINED, never RELEASE_CANDIDATE

description.th: กติกา identity และ version ของ artifact — snapshot ที่ไม่ถูกแก้ทับ
description.en: Artifact identity and version rules — snapshots that are never overwritten.

items.text_th: Separate Identity — source-derived artifact และ organization-derived artifact มี artifact_id คนละตัวเสมอ เช่น ctrl_nist_ac_2 กับ int_ctrl_nist_ac_2_v1 ตาม naming convention ใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Separate Identity — source-derived and organization-derived artifacts always have different artifact_id values, e.g. ctrl_nist_ac_2 vs int_ctrl_nist_ac_2_v1 per the GLOSSARY.md naming convention

items.text_th: Immutable Versions — artifact_version ใช้ semver (1.0.0-rc1 → 1.0.0); การเปลี่ยนเนื้อหาสร้าง version ใหม่พร้อม content_hash ใหม่ ห้าม mutate snapshot เดิม
items.text_en: Immutable Versions — artifact_version uses semver (1.0.0-rc1 → 1.0.0); any content change creates a new version with a new content_hash, never mutating the old snapshot

items.text_th: Supersession Link — version ใหม่ต้อง trace ถึง version เดิมผ่าน lineage ที่ PROVENANCE_MODEL.md กำหนด; version เดิมเปลี่ยน lifecycle เป็น SUPERSEDED ไม่ถูกลบ
items.text_en: Supersession Link — a new version must trace to the previous one through the lineage PROVENANCE_MODEL.md defines; the old version moves to lifecycle SUPERSEDED and is never deleted

description.th: อะไรต้องถูก persist เพื่อให้ audit และ replay ได้ โดยเฉพาะ activity ที่ nondeterministic
description.en: What must be persisted so audits and replays are possible, especially for nondeterministic activities.

items.text_th: Deterministic Activities — parser/normalizer ที่ replay ได้จาก input + config_hash ต้องให้ output hash เดิม; ใช้เป็น regression check
items.text_en: Deterministic Activities — parsers/normalizers replayable from input + config_hash must reproduce the same output hash; used as a regression check

items.text_th: Nondeterministic Activities — LLM semantic extraction เก็บ model, prompt version จาก PROMPT_SPEC.md, temperature และ config แต่ยอมรับว่าไม่พอสำหรับ exact replay
items.text_en: Nondeterministic Activities — LLM semantic extraction records model, prompt version from PROMPT_SPEC.md, temperature and config, while accepting these are insufficient for exact replay

items.text_th: Persist Actual Output — เมื่อต้อง exact audit ตามระดับใน CONSTRAINTS.md ให้ persist artifact ที่ผลิตจริงพร้อม content_hash แทนการหวังจะ regenerate ให้เหมือนเดิม
items.text_en: Persist Actual Output — when the audit level in CONSTRAINTS.md requires exact audit, persist the actually produced artifact with its content_hash rather than hoping to regenerate it identically

description.th: Contract ของ Stage 1 — source_record/v1.4 ที่นิยาม identity, version, upstream vs acquired representation, integrity/authenticity evidence, temporal semantics และ governance blocks ของ source ทุกชิ้นก่อนเข้า pipeline
description.en: The Stage 1 contract — source_record/v1.4 defining identity, version, upstream vs acquired representation, integrity/authenticity evidence, temporal semantics and governance blocks for every source before it enters the pipeline.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a SOURCE_CONTRACT.md specifying source_record/v1.4 — the record every source in the catalog must satisfy before Stage 2 runs. List every top-level field with type, required and nullable: source_id, capability_profile_ref (resolved against the SOURCE_CATALOG.md profile set), title, publisher, document_identity {base_reference, edition, revision, modifiers[]}, publication_date, publication_date_basis, alternate_source_observations[], effective_date, retrieved_at, language, upstream_source {canonical_uri, source_format, relationship, release_ref, immutable_ref, reference_stability}, acquired_representation {path_or_object_ref, representation_format, expected_content_hash, actual_content_hash}, authenticity {acquisition_channel, signature_verified, signature_ref, trusted_registry_ref}, rights, information_governance, source_authority, intended_uses[], use_authorization, trust_boundary, source_status. Explain the upstream ≠ acquired invariant: the hash is bound to the bytes the pipeline actually reads, never to a different upstream format. Separate integrity (hash equality) from authenticity (channel, signature, registry). Document temporal fields (published_at, approved_at, effective_from, effective_until, retrieved_at, superseded_at) and the version graph (edition/revision/amendment/corrigendum/errata; supersedes/superseded_by) and the rule for conflicting official metadata (keep publication_date_basis and alternate_source_observations rather than silently reconciling). Show which blocks are owned by other documents and only embedded here. Close with the nine acceptance criteria as decidable checks.
agent_hints.input_context: Every source in SOURCE_CATALOG.md must be expressible as one source_record/v1.4. Governance blocks (rights, information_governance, use_authorization, trust_boundary) embed records owned by USE_AUTHORIZATION.md and TRUST_BOUNDARY.md; the record does not carry the shared envelope — it references envelope enums only through its use_authorization / trust_boundary blocks and its source_status. Use the fictional sources from the facts sheet as worked examples only.
agent_hints.validation: Every field of source_record/v1.4 must state type, required and nullable. The upstream ≠ acquired invariant and the hash ≠ authenticity rule must each be stated with a violation example. document_identity must support base publication plus modifiers, not a single version field. Every acceptance criterion must be phrased so a validator can reject a violating record. source_status must list all six allowed values.

description.th: Field ระดับบนของ source_record/v1.4 และ identity ของ source
description.en: Top-level fields of source_record/v1.4 and source identity.

items.text_th: Identity Fields — source_id (stable, ตาม prefix src_ ใน GLOSSARY.md), title, publisher (nullable), language (nullable), retrieved_at (required) เช่น src_nist_sp800_53_r5
items.text_en: Identity Fields — source_id (stable, using the src_ prefix from GLOSSARY.md), title, publisher (nullable), language (nullable), retrieved_at (required) e.g. src_nist_sp800_53_r5

items.text_th: document_identity — object required: base_reference, edition, revision (nullable ทั้งสาม) และ modifiers[] (required, อาจว่าง) แทน field version เดียว
items.text_en: document_identity — required object: base_reference, edition, revision (all nullable) and modifiers[] (required, may be empty) instead of a single version field

items.text_th: Catalog Alignment — ทุก source ใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md ต้องแปลงเป็น source record หนึ่งฉบับได้โดยไม่ต้องเพิ่ม field นอก contract
items.text_en: Catalog Alignment — every source in SOURCE_CATALOG.md must map to exactly one source record without fields outside the contract

items.text_th: capability_profile_ref — required, ชี้ไป capability profile ตัวเดียวใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md ที่บอกว่า capability ไหนของ pipeline ใช้กับ source นี้; validator resolve ค่านี้จริงและ reject id ที่ไม่มีอยู่ — stage ที่ profile บอกว่า NOT_APPLICABLE จะไม่ถูกเรียกและ VALIDATION_SPEC.md รายงาน NOT_APPLICABLE แทน PASS
items.text_en: capability_profile_ref — required, pointing at exactly one capability profile in SOURCE_CATALOG.md that says which pipeline capabilities apply to this source; the validator resolves it and rejects an unknown id — a stage the profile marks NOT_APPLICABLE is not run and VALIDATION_SPEC.md reports NOT_APPLICABLE instead of PASS

description.th: แยก identity ของ publication ต้นทางออกจาก representation ที่ pipeline ประมวลผลจริง
description.en: Separating the upstream publication's identity from the representation the pipeline actually processes.

items.text_th: upstream_source — canonical_uri, source_format, relationship (เช่น OFFICIAL_RELEASE, METADATA_REFERENCE_FOR_CONTROLLED_COPY), release_ref, immutable_ref (nullable), reference_stability (เช่น DOI_PERSISTENT, TAGGED_RELEASE)
items.text_en: upstream_source — canonical_uri, source_format, relationship (e.g. OFFICIAL_RELEASE, METADATA_REFERENCE_FOR_CONTROLLED_COPY), release_ref, immutable_ref (nullable), reference_stability (e.g. DOI_PERSISTENT, TAGGED_RELEASE)

items.text_th: acquired_representation — path_or_object_ref, representation_format, expected_content_hash, actual_content_hash; นี่คือ input ที่ EXTRACTION_SPEC.md อ่านจริง
items.text_en: acquired_representation — path_or_object_ref, representation_format, expected_content_hash, actual_content_hash; this is the input EXTRACTION_SPEC.md actually reads

items.text_th: Hash Binding Invariant — hash ต้องผูกกับ representation ที่อ่านจริง; ห้ามเอา hash ของ Markdown snapshot ไปอ้างเป็น hash ของ PDF/HTML upstream ที่ระบุใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md
items.text_en: Hash Binding Invariant — the hash is bound to the representation actually read; never present a Markdown snapshot's hash as the hash of the upstream PDF/HTML listed in SOURCE_CATALOG.md

items.text_th: Sanitized Derivative — source ที่ contains_personal_data = true มี sanitized representation ที่ derive จาก acquired_representation ตาม EXTRACTION_SPEC.md; แต่ละ representation มี content_hash ของตัวเอง และ hash binding invariant ใช้แยกกัน — ห้ามเอา hash ของ sanitized ไปอ้างเป็น hash ของต้นฉบับ
items.text_en: Sanitized Derivative — a source whose contains_personal_data is true has a sanitized representation derived from the acquired_representation per EXTRACTION_SPEC.md; each representation carries its own content_hash and the hash-binding invariant applies to each separately — a sanitized hash is never presented as the original's hash

description.th: Hash พิสูจน์ integrity เท่านั้น — authenticity ต้องมี evidence แยก
description.en: A hash proves integrity only — authenticity needs separate evidence.

items.text_th: Integrity Check — expected_content_hash ต้องเท่ากับ actual_content_hash ก่อน Stage 2 รัน; ไม่เท่า = block และบันทึก issue
items.text_en: Integrity Check — expected_content_hash must equal actual_content_hash before Stage 2 runs; mismatch blocks processing and records an issue

items.text_th: authenticity Block — acquisition_channel (required เช่น PUBLISHER_DOWNLOAD_HTTPS, CONTROLLED_PURCHASED_COPY, INTERNAL_DMS, WEB_SNAPSHOT — ค่าตัวอย่างนิยามที่นี่), signature_verified (nullable boolean), signature_ref, trusted_registry_ref ที่ตรงกับ evidence ใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md
items.text_en: authenticity Block — acquisition_channel (required, e.g. PUBLISHER_DOWNLOAD_HTTPS, CONTROLLED_PURCHASED_COPY, INTERNAL_DMS, WEB_SNAPSHOT — example values owned here), signature_verified (nullable boolean), signature_ref, trusted_registry_ref matching the evidence in SOURCE_CATALOG.md

items.text_th: Assurance Level — source ที่ CONSTRAINTS.md จัดเป็น high-assurance ต้องมี authenticity evidence มากกว่า hash เช่น publisher signature หรือ signed registry
items.text_en: Assurance Level — sources CONSTRAINTS.md classifies as high-assurance need authenticity evidence beyond the hash, e.g. a publisher signature or signed registry

description.th: Source ไม่มีวันที่เดียวหรือ version เดียว — field และ version graph ที่ต้องรองรับ
description.en: A source has no single date or version — the fields and version graph the contract must support.

items.text_th: Temporal Fields — publication_date, effective_date, retrieved_at และเมื่อทราบ approved_at, effective_until, superseded_at; ห้ามใช้ field date เดียวแทนทุกความหมาย
items.text_en: Temporal Fields — publication_date, effective_date, retrieved_at and, when known, approved_at, effective_until, superseded_at; one date field never stands in for all meanings

items.text_th: Version Graph — modifiers[] ชนิด AMENDMENT, ADDENDUM, CORRIGENDUM, ERRATA (UPDATE เป็น SourceVault extension สำหรับ update bundle ของ publisher) พร้อม reference และ publication_date — นิยาม modifier type ที่เดียวที่นี่; ความสัมพันธ์ supersedes / superseded_by บันทึกใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md ต่อ source
items.text_en: Version Graph — modifiers[] of type AMENDMENT, ADDENDUM, CORRIGENDUM, ERRATA (UPDATE is a SourceVault extension for publisher update bundles) with reference and publication_date — this is the single definition of modifier types; supersedes / superseded_by relationships are recorded per source in SOURCE_CATALOG.md

items.text_th: Conflicting Official Metadata — เก็บ publication_date_basis และ alternate_source_observations[] แทนการเลือกค่าเดียวแล้วลบ evidence อีกฝั่ง; derived artifact ของ version เดิมไม่ถูก mutate ตาม PROVENANCE_MODEL.md
items.text_en: Conflicting Official Metadata — keep publication_date_basis and alternate_source_observations[] rather than picking one value and dropping the other evidence; derived artifacts of the old version are never mutated, per PROVENANCE_MODEL.md

description.th: Block ที่เอกสารอื่นเป็นเจ้าของ แต่ต้อง embed ใน source record
description.en: Blocks owned by other documents but embedded in the source record.

items.text_th: rights และ information_governance — rights_holder, license_type, license_ref, restrictions[], evidence_refs[]; classification, contains_personal_data, confidentiality_constraints[], access_policy_refs[], data_residency_constraints[], ai_processing_policy_refs[] — evidence แยก traceable ตาม USE_AUTHORIZATION.md
items.text_en: rights and information_governance — rights_holder, license_type, license_ref, restrictions[], evidence_refs[]; classification, contains_personal_data, confidentiality_constraints[], access_policy_refs[], data_residency_constraints[], ai_processing_policy_refs[] — evidence separately traceable per USE_AUTHORIZATION.md

items.text_th: intended_uses[] และ use_authorization — {operation, purpose, target} ต่อ intended use และ authorization {authorization_id, overall_status, decisions[]} ที่ decision แต่ละข้อนิยามใน USE_AUTHORIZATION.md
items.text_en: intended_uses[] and use_authorization — {operation, purpose, target} per intended use and authorization {authorization_id, overall_status, decisions[]} whose per-decision semantics are defined in USE_AUTHORIZATION.md

items.text_th: trust_boundary และ source_status — source_trust, embedded_instruction_policy, สาม boolean ของ extractor privilege ตาม TRUST_BOUNDARY.md; source_status ∈ {ACTIVE, SUPERSEDED, WITHDRAWN, DRAFT, UNKNOWN, ARCHIVED}
items.text_en: trust_boundary and source_status — source_trust, embedded_instruction_policy, the three extractor-privilege booleans per TRUST_BOUNDARY.md; source_status ∈ {ACTIVE, SUPERSEDED, WITHDRAWN, DRAFT, UNKNOWN, ARCHIVED}

description.th: เกณฑ์ที่ source record ต้องผ่านก่อน downstream stage ทำงาน
description.en: Criteria a source record must meet before any downstream stage runs.

items.text_th: Identity Criteria — upstream identity แยกจาก acquired representation; base publication กับ modifiers แยกแยะได้; conflicting metadata ถูกเก็บพร้อม basis/evidence
items.text_en: Identity Criteria — upstream identity separate from the acquired representation; base publication distinguishable from modifiers; conflicting metadata preserved with basis/evidence

items.text_th: Integrity Criteria — expected_content_hash เท่ากับ bytes/text ที่ประมวลผลจริง และ hash ไม่ถูกใช้เป็น authenticity proof โดยตัวเอง
items.text_en: Integrity Criteria — expected_content_hash equals the bytes/text actually processed, and the hash is not treated as authenticity proof by itself

items.text_th: Governance Criteria — ทุก intended operation มี decision; DENY/UNKNOWN/NEEDS_REVIEW block operation นั้น; rights กับ info-gov evidence แยก traceable; external content เป็น data และ extractor ไม่มี side-effect tools/secrets/connectors — ตรวจใน layer ที่ VALIDATION_SPEC.md กำหนด และบันทึกผลใน envelope ตาม ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md
items.text_en: Governance Criteria — every intended operation has a decision; DENY/UNKNOWN/NEEDS_REVIEW block that operation; rights and info-gov evidence separately traceable; external content is data and the extractor has no side-effect tools/secrets/connectors — checked in the layers VALIDATION_SPEC.md defines and recorded in the envelope per ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md

description.th: Contract ของ Stage 2 — แปลง native format เป็น source-faithful intermediate representation: strategy ต่อ format, element type vocabulary, source_extraction/v1.0, table/figure fidelity, OCR และ sanitization
description.en: The Stage 2 contract — converting native formats into a source-faithful intermediate representation: strategy per format, element type vocabulary, source_extraction/v1.0, table/figure fidelity, OCR and sanitization.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an EXTRACTION_SPEC.md defining how each source format (PDF, DOCX, HTML, spreadsheet, API documentation, database export, scanned image) is converted into extracted elements without interpreting meaning. For every format state the strategy (native parser, OCR, API, SQL export, hybrid), the tool and pinned version, and what structure it preserves. Define the element type vocabulary as the canonical enum: HEADING, PARAGRAPH, LIST_ITEM, TABLE, TABLE_ROW, TABLE_CELL, NOTE, FOOTNOTE, CAPTION, FIGURE_REF, LINK, CODE_BLOCK, FORM_FIELD. Document the source_extraction/v1.0 contract: extraction_id, source_id, extractor {name, version, config_hash}, elements[] {element_id, element_type, verbatim_text, page_or_location_ref, parent_element_id, structural_path[]} and its acceptance criteria (elements point to source locations; verbatim text never silently rewritten; tables and hierarchy stay distinguishable). Specify table, figure and cross-layout fidelity rules: table identity, row/column headers, cell coordinates, merged cells, captions and footnotes are meaning, not decoration. Specify OCR handling: record ocr_engine, ocr_version, confidence and page/image reference, and state that OCR confidence is not semantic correctness. State where sanitization runs so extracted text enters later stages as data. Close with the redaction path for sources carrying personal data: the access-restricted original versus the sanitized representation, the version-pinned redaction_profile with its detectors, entity types and per-type action, the source_redaction/v1.0 contract emitted by a REDACT activity, the redaction map kept out of every artifact, re-identification as its own authorized operation, and the rule that evidence anchors bind to the sanitized text a model actually read. Say plainly that sanitization (injection defence) and redaction (privacy) are different passes with different triggers.
agent_hints.input_context: Input is the acquired_representation declared in SOURCE_CONTRACT.md after its hash check passes. Extracted elements carry the envelope from ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md and are the only input to segmentation. Extraction runs inside the privilege profile of TRUST_BOUNDARY.md.
agent_hints.validation: Every source format in scope must have a strategy with a named, version-pinned tool. All 13 element types must be listed exactly once. Every field of source_extraction/v1.0 must state type, required and nullable. Table fidelity rules must name which table properties are preserved. OCR outputs must be distinguishable from native text in the contract, and the document must state that a capability the profile marks NOT_APPLICABLE leaves its block absent rather than null. Every field of source_redaction/v1.0 must state type, required and nullable; the redaction profile must list its detectors, entity types and per-type action; the document must state that the redaction map never appears in an artifact and that re-identification needs its own authorization decision.

description.th: วิธี extract ต่อ format พร้อม tool และ version ที่ pin
description.en: Extraction method per format with pinned tool and version.

items.text_th: Format → Strategy Matrix — PDF native parser, DOCX native parser, HTML DOM parser, spreadsheet/CSV structured reader, API docs via OpenAPI/API export, DB export via SQL, scan/image via OCR, hybrid เมื่อจำเป็น
items.text_en: Format → Strategy Matrix — PDF native parser, DOCX native parser, HTML DOM parser, spreadsheet/CSV structured reader, API docs via OpenAPI/API export, DB export via SQL, scan/image via OCR, hybrid where needed

items.text_th: Tool Pinning — ชื่อและ version ของ parser ต่อ format เช่น pdf-structure-parser 2.3.1 พร้อม config_hash; เลือกจาก tooling ที่ CONSTRAINTS.md อนุญาต
items.text_en: Tool Pinning — parser name and version per format, e.g. pdf-structure-parser 2.3.1 with config_hash; chosen from tooling CONSTRAINTS.md permits

items.text_th: Input Precondition — อ่านเฉพาะ acquired_representation ที่ผ่าน hash check ใน SOURCE_CONTRACT.md และเฉพาะเมื่อ operation PARSE ได้รับอนุญาต
items.text_en: Input Precondition — read only the acquired_representation that passed the SOURCE_CONTRACT.md hash check, and only when the PARSE operation is authorized

description.th: Enum canonical ของ element type ที่ extractor ผลิตได้
description.en: The canonical enum of element types an extractor may produce.

items.text_th: Text Structure — HEADING, PARAGRAPH, LIST_ITEM, NOTE, FOOTNOTE, CAPTION
items.text_en: Text Structure — HEADING, PARAGRAPH, LIST_ITEM, NOTE, FOOTNOTE, CAPTION

items.text_th: Tables and References — TABLE, TABLE_ROW, TABLE_CELL, FIGURE_REF, LINK
items.text_en: Tables and References — TABLE, TABLE_ROW, TABLE_CELL, FIGURE_REF, LINK

items.text_th: Technical Elements — CODE_BLOCK, FORM_FIELD; ค่าทั้ง 13 ถูก index ใน Enumeration Registry ของ GLOSSARY.md แต่นิยามที่นี่เท่านั้น
items.text_en: Technical Elements — CODE_BLOCK, FORM_FIELD; all 13 values are indexed in the GLOSSARY.md Enumeration Registry but defined only here

description.th: source_extraction/v1.0 — field และ acceptance criteria
description.en: source_extraction/v1.0 — fields and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Extraction Header — extraction_id, source_id (ตรงกับ SOURCE_CONTRACT.md), extractor {name, version, config_hash} ทั้งหมด required; extraction run emit transformation_activity ชนิด EXTRACT ตาม ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md ไม่ได้ห่อด้วย envelope เอง
items.text_en: Extraction Header — extraction_id, source_id (matching SOURCE_CONTRACT.md), extractor {name, version, config_hash} all required; the extraction run emits a transformation_activity of type EXTRACT per ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md rather than carrying the envelope itself

items.text_th: Element Schema — element_id, element_type, verbatim_text (nullable), page_or_location_ref (required เช่น pdf:page=18), parent_element_id (nullable), structural_path[] (required)
items.text_en: Element Schema — element_id, element_type, verbatim_text (nullable), page_or_location_ref (required, e.g. pdf:page=18), parent_element_id (nullable), structural_path[] (required)

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — ทุก element ชี้ตำแหน่งใน source; verbatim_text ไม่ถูก rewrite เงียบ ๆ; table และ hierarchy แยกจาก paragraph ได้เท่าที่เทคนิคทำได้
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — every element points to a source location; verbatim_text is never silently rewritten; tables and hierarchy stay distinguishable from paragraphs where technically possible

description.th: ตารางและ figure เป็นส่วนของความหมาย ไม่ใช่ decoration
description.en: Tables and figures are part of the meaning, not decoration.

items.text_th: Table Properties Preserved — table identity, row/column headers, cell coordinates, merged-cell semantics เมื่อสำคัญ, caption และ footnotes
items.text_en: Table Properties Preserved — table identity, row/column headers, cell coordinates, merged-cell semantics where they matter, caption and footnotes

items.text_th: Figure and Cross-Reference Elements — FIGURE_REF และ LINK เก็บ target ตามที่ปรากฏ; การ resolve target เป็นงานของ NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md ไม่ใช่ของ extractor
items.text_en: Figure and Cross-Reference Elements — FIGURE_REF and LINK keep the target as it appears; resolving the target is the job of NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md, not the extractor

items.text_th: Hierarchy Signals — structural_path และ parent_element_id ต้องพอให้ SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md สร้าง hierarchy-aware boundary ได้
items.text_en: Hierarchy Signals — structural_path and parent_element_id must be sufficient for SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md to build hierarchy-aware boundaries

items.text_th: Capability-Scoped Fidelity — table_fidelity และ figure_interpretation เปิด/ปิดตาม capability profile ของ family: family ที่ figure_interpretation NOT_APPLICABLE ยังเก็บ FIGURE_REF เป็น element ได้ตามปกติ แต่ไม่มี artifact ใดอ้างความหมายของรูป และ validation layer ที่เกี่ยวข้องรายงาน NOT_APPLICABLE
items.text_en: Capability-Scoped Fidelity — table_fidelity and figure_interpretation are switched on or off by the family's capability profile: a family where figure_interpretation is NOT_APPLICABLE still keeps FIGURE_REF elements, but no artifact claims a figure's meaning and the corresponding validation layer reports NOT_APPLICABLE

description.th: กติกาเมื่อ source เป็น scan/image
description.en: Rules when the source is a scan or image.

items.text_th: OCR Metadata — เก็บ ocr_engine, ocr_version, confidence (เมื่อมี) และ source image/page reference ต่อ element
