items.text_en: OCR Metadata — record ocr_engine, ocr_version, confidence (when available) and the source image/page reference per element

items.text_th: Confidence Is Not Correctness — OCR confidence สูงไม่ได้แปลว่าตีความ requirement ถูก; extraction coverage ตรวจใน VALIDATION_SPEC.md แยกจาก OCR score
items.text_en: Confidence Is Not Correctness — high OCR confidence does not mean the requirement is interpreted correctly; extraction coverage is checked in VALIDATION_SPEC.md separately from OCR scores

items.text_th: Distinguishability — element จาก OCR ต้องแยกจาก native text ได้ และ OCR engine ต้องอยู่ในรายการที่ CONSTRAINTS.md อนุญาต
items.text_en: Distinguishability — OCR-derived elements must be distinguishable from native text, and the OCR engine must be on the list CONSTRAINTS.md permits

items.text_th: Capability Gate — source ที่ capability profile ใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md ประกาศ ocr: NOT_APPLICABLE ไม่มี block ocr เลย (ไม่ใช่ null และไม่ใช่ object ว่าง) และ VALIDATION_SPEC.md รายงาน OCR layer เป็น NOT_APPLICABLE; ถ้ามี block ocr โผล่มาบน family ที่ปิดไว้ = validator reject
items.text_en: Capability Gate — a source whose SOURCE_CATALOG.md capability profile declares ocr: NOT_APPLICABLE carries no ocr block at all (not null, not an empty object) and VALIDATION_SPEC.md reports the OCR layer as NOT_APPLICABLE; an ocr block appearing on a family where the capability is off is rejected by the validator

description.th: จุดที่ sanitizer ทำงานเพื่อให้ข้อความที่ extract เข้า stage ถัดไปเป็น data
description.en: Where the sanitizer runs so extracted text enters later stages as data.

items.text_th: Sanitizer Position — รันหลัง parser ก่อนส่ง elements ให้ segmentation ตาม safe representation path ใน TRUST_BOUNDARY.md
items.text_en: Sanitizer Position — runs after the parser and before elements reach segmentation, per the safe representation path in TRUST_BOUNDARY.md

items.text_th: Preserve Verbatim — sanitizer ทำ flag/escape (เช่น INJECTION_SUSPECTED) ไม่ลบหรือแก้ verbatim_text; embedded instruction ยังคงเป็น quoted data
items.text_en: Preserve Verbatim — the sanitizer flags/escapes (e.g. INJECTION_SUSPECTED) without deleting or altering verbatim_text; embedded instructions remain quoted data

items.text_th: Extractor Privilege — extractor รันโดยไม่มี secrets, side-effect tools หรือ privileged connectors ตาม privilege profile ใน TRUST_BOUNDARY.md
items.text_en: Extractor Privilege — the extractor runs without secrets, side-effect tools or privileged connectors per the TRUST_BOUNDARY.md privilege profile

description.th: เส้นทางของ source ที่มีข้อมูลส่วนบุคคล — original ที่จำกัดสิทธิ์ vs sanitized representation ที่ model อ่าน พร้อม provenance ของการ redact
description.en: The path for sources carrying personal data — the access-restricted original versus the sanitized representation a model reads, with redaction provenance.

items.text_th: Two Representations — acquired_representation (ต้นฉบับ เก็บใน store ที่จำกัดสิทธิ์) แยกจาก sanitized_representation {path_or_object_ref, content_hash, derived_from_representation_hash, redaction_profile_ref, redaction_map_ref}; model และทุก target นอก secure boundary อ่านได้เฉพาะตัว sanitized — ต้นฉบับไม่ออกจาก store; hash binding invariant ของ SOURCE_CONTRACT.md ใช้กับแต่ละ representation แยกกัน
items.text_en: Two Representations — the acquired_representation (the original, held in an access-restricted store) is separate from the sanitized_representation {path_or_object_ref, content_hash, derived_from_representation_hash, redaction_profile_ref, redaction_map_ref}; models and every target outside the secure boundary read only the sanitized one and the original never leaves the store; the SOURCE_CONTRACT.md hash-binding invariant applies to each representation independently

items.text_th: Detection Profile — redaction_profile {profile_id, version, detectors[] ∈ RULE / DICTIONARY / MODEL, entity_types[] เช่น PERSON_NAME, NATIONAL_ID, EMAIL, PHONE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ADDRESS, action ต่อ type ∈ MASK / HASH / TOKENIZE / REMOVE, locale} pin version + config_hash เหมือน tool อื่นใน Tool Pinning; ห้ามสมมติว่า detector recall = 100% — ต้องระบุ residual risk และ entity type ที่ประกาศไว้แต่ไม่มี detector ทำให้ condition ไม่ผ่าน
items.text_en: Detection Profile — redaction_profile {profile_id, version, detectors[] ∈ RULE / DICTIONARY / MODEL, entity_types[] such as PERSON_NAME, NATIONAL_ID, EMAIL, PHONE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ADDRESS, an action per type ∈ MASK / HASH / TOKENIZE / REMOVE, locale}, version-pinned with a config_hash like every other tool in Tool Pinning; detector recall is never assumed to be complete — residual risk is stated, and a declared entity type with no detector means the condition cannot be satisfied

items.text_th: Redaction Contract and Provenance — source_redaction/v1.0: redaction_id, source_id, source_representation_hash, sanitized_representation, profile, counts_by_entity_type, redaction_map_ref, activity_id; เกิดจาก REDACT activity ตาม ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md ระหว่าง Acquire กับ Extract; redaction map (span เดิม → placeholder) อยู่ใน secure store ห้ามอยู่ใน artifact หรือ manifest และการ re-identify เป็น operation × purpose × target ของตัวเองที่ต้องมี decision ใน USE_AUTHORIZATION.md
items.text_en: Redaction Contract and Provenance — source_redaction/v1.0: redaction_id, source_id, source_representation_hash, sanitized_representation, profile, counts_by_entity_type, redaction_map_ref, activity_id; emitted by a REDACT activity per ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md between Acquire and Extract; the redaction map (original span → placeholder) lives in the secure store and never inside an artifact or manifest, and re-identification is its own operation × purpose × target needing its own decision in USE_AUTHORIZATION.md

items.text_th: Anchor Interaction — evidence anchor ผูกกับ representation ที่อ่านจริง ดังนั้น source ที่ redact แล้ว excerpt_hash ผูกกับข้อความ sanitized ตามกติกา anchor binding ของ SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md; artifact ต้องไม่ quote ข้อความที่ถูก redact ออกไปแล้ว และ span ที่ตกอยู่ในช่วง placeholder ต้อง resolve เป็น placeholder ไม่ใช่ค่าเดิม
items.text_en: Anchor Interaction — an evidence anchor binds to the representation actually read, so for a redacted source the excerpt_hash binds to the sanitized text under the SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md anchor-binding rule; an artifact must never quote text that was redacted away, and a span falling inside a placeholder resolves to the placeholder, not to the original value

description.th: Contract ของ Stage 3 — กำหนด semantic/source boundary ที่เหมาะกับ document type, segment identity, source_segmentation/v1.0 และกติกาว่า semantic segment ไม่ใช่ retrieval chunk
description.en: The Stage 3 contract — semantic/source boundaries appropriate to each document type, segment identity, source_segmentation/v1.0, and the rule that a semantic segment is not a retrieval chunk.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md defining how extracted elements become semantic segments. State the principle: segment by meaning first, chunk for retrieval later — fixed-size splitting can cut a requirement mid-sentence or detach an exception from its rule. Define boundary rules per document type (clause, control, requirement, definition, procedure step, policy rule, table row group, API endpoint, FAQ entry) using hierarchy signals from extraction. Define segment identity: segment_id, source_id, source_element_ids[], hierarchy_path[], verbatim_content, segment_type_hint, previous_segment_id, next_segment_id. Document the source_segmentation/v1.0 contract and its acceptance criteria (no silent content loss; every segment maps to one or more elements; parent-child context reconstructable). Close with the semantic segment vs retrieval chunk boundary: retrieval representations (title-only embedding, parent summary, neighbor windows) are derived later and must link back to segment_id, never replace it.
agent_hints.input_context: Input is the element list produced under EXTRACTION_SPEC.md. Segments carry the envelope from ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md and the segment ≠ chunk boundary pair from GLOSSARY.md. Segments are the evidence units every semantic artifact points to.
agent_hints.validation: Every document type in scope must have a boundary rule that names the extraction signals it uses. Every field of source_segmentation/v1.0 must state type, required and nullable. Acceptance criteria must include the no-silent-loss check. The segment ≠ chunk rule must state that retrieval representations link back to segment_id.

description.th: หลักการแบ่งตามความหมายก่อน และสิ่งที่ fixed-size chunking ทำพัง
description.en: The meaning-first principle and what fixed-size chunking breaks.

items.text_th: Meaning-First Rule — แบ่งตาม semantic/source boundary ก่อน; การตัดทุก 500 tokens อาจตัด requirement กลางประโยค หรือแยก exception ออกจาก rule
items.text_en: Meaning-First Rule — split on semantic/source boundaries first; cutting every 500 tokens can split a requirement mid-sentence or detach an exception from its rule

items.text_th: Hierarchy-Aware Input — ใช้ structural_path, parent_element_id และ element_type จาก EXTRACTION_SPEC.md เป็น signal หลักในการวาง boundary
items.text_en: Hierarchy-Aware Input — use structural_path, parent_element_id and element_type from EXTRACTION_SPEC.md as the primary boundary signals

items.text_th: Terminology — segment, retrieval chunk และ semantic artifact เป็นคนละ term ตาม Boundary Pairs ใน GLOSSARY.md; ห้ามใช้แทนกัน
items.text_en: Terminology — segment, retrieval chunk and semantic artifact are distinct terms per the GLOSSARY.md Boundary Pairs; never use them interchangeably

description.th: กติกา boundary ต่อชนิดเอกสารในขอบเขต
description.en: Boundary rules per document type in scope.

items.text_th: Normative Documents — standard/regulation/policy แบ่งเป็น Clause, Control, Requirement, Definition, Policy Rule โดยใช้ HEADING + numbering จาก EXTRACTION_SPEC.md เช่น seg_nist53r5_ac_2
items.text_en: Normative Documents — standards/regulations/policies split into Clause, Control, Requirement, Definition, Policy Rule using HEADING + numbering from EXTRACTION_SPEC.md, e.g. seg_nist53r5_ac_2

items.text_th: Procedural and Tabular Documents — Procedure Step ตาม LIST_ITEM ลำดับ, Table Row Group ตาม TABLE_ROW ที่ share header เดียวกัน
items.text_en: Procedural and Tabular Documents — Procedure Step per ordered LIST_ITEM, Table Row Group per TABLE_ROW set sharing one header

items.text_th: Technical and Web Documents — API Endpoint, FAQ Entry, product doc section; ชนิดเอกสารที่ต้องรองรับมาจาก scope ใน SOURCE_DOMAIN.md
items.text_en: Technical and Web Documents — API Endpoint, FAQ Entry, product doc section; the document types to support come from the scope in SOURCE_DOMAIN.md

description.th: สิ่งที่ segment ต้องตอบได้ — identity, span, hierarchy และเพื่อนบ้าน
description.en: What a segment must answer — identity, span, hierarchy and neighbors.

items.text_th: Identity — segment_id (prefix seg_ ตาม GLOSSARY.md), source_id, source_element_ids[] ที่ชี้ element ใน EXTRACTION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Identity — segment_id (seg_ prefix per GLOSSARY.md), source_id, source_element_ids[] pointing to EXTRACTION_SPEC.md elements

items.text_th: Content and Hierarchy — verbatim_content (required, ห้าม paraphrase), hierarchy_path[] เช่น ["Chapter Three", "3.1 Access Control", "AC-2 Account Management"], segment_type_hint (nullable เช่น CONTROL)
items.text_en: Content and Hierarchy — verbatim_content (required, never paraphrased), hierarchy_path[] e.g. ["Chapter Three", "3.1 Access Control", "AC-2 Account Management"], segment_type_hint (nullable, e.g. CONTROL)

items.text_th: Neighbors — previous_segment_id และ next_segment_id (nullable) เพื่อสร้าง context window ภายหลังโดยไม่ต้องรวม segment
items.text_en: Neighbors — previous_segment_id and next_segment_id (nullable) so context windows can be built later without merging segments

description.th: source_segmentation/v1.0 — field และ acceptance criteria
description.en: source_segmentation/v1.0 — fields and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Contract Shape — segments[] ของ {segment_id, source_id, source_element_ids[], hierarchy_path[], verbatim_content, segment_type_hint, previous_segment_id, next_segment_id}; segmentation run emit transformation_activity ชนิด SEGMENT ตาม ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md
items.text_en: Contract Shape — segments[] of {segment_id, source_id, source_element_ids[], hierarchy_path[], verbatim_content, segment_type_hint, previous_segment_id, next_segment_id}; the segmentation run emits a transformation_activity of type SEGMENT per ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — boundary ไม่ลบเนื้อหาเงียบ ๆ; ทุก segment map กับ element อย่างน้อยหนึ่งตัว; parent-child context สร้างกลับได้เมื่อ hierarchy สำคัญ
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — boundaries never silently delete content; every segment maps to at least one element; parent-child context is reconstructable when hierarchy matters

items.text_th: Coverage Check — ผลรวม verbatim_content ของทุก segment ต้องครอบคลุม verbatim_text ของ element ทั้งหมด; ตรวจใน Segmentation Integrity layer ของ VALIDATION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Coverage Check — the union of all segments' verbatim_content must cover every element's verbatim_text; checked in the Segmentation Integrity layer of VALIDATION_SPEC.md

description.th: Retrieval representation เป็น derived artifact ที่ link กลับ segment เสมอ
description.en: Retrieval representations are derived artifacts that always link back to the segment.

items.text_th: Definition — semantic segment คือ domain knowledge unit; retrieval chunk คือ IR/optimization representation; boundary pair นี้อยู่ใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Definition — a semantic segment is a domain knowledge unit; a retrieval chunk is an IR/optimization representation; this boundary pair lives in GLOSSARY.md

items.text_th: Derived Representations — title-only embedding, control + neighboring text, parent section summary สร้างได้หลายแบบจาก segment เดียว และทุกแบบเก็บ segment_id เดิม
items.text_en: Derived Representations — title-only embedding, control + neighboring text, parent-section summary may all be built from one segment, and every one keeps the original segment_id

items.text_th: Ownership — การสร้าง retrieval derivatives เป็น downstream ของ published artifact ตาม PUBLICATION_SPEC.md; ห้ามสร้างในขั้น segmentation
items.text_en: Ownership — building retrieval derivatives is downstream of the published artifact per PUBLICATION_SPEC.md; never done during segmentation

description.th: Contract ของ Stage 4 — artifact type vocabulary, สาม semantic layer (source assertion / derived / interpretation), semantic_artifact/v1.1, authorship labels, กติกาการใช้ model และ evidence linkage
description.en: The Stage 4 contract — artifact type vocabulary, three semantic layers (source assertion / derived / interpretation), semantic_artifact/v1.1, authorship labels, model-use rules and evidence linkage.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md defining what a segment becomes in domain terms. Start with a small controlled artifact_type vocabulary (REQUIREMENT, CONTROL_REFERENCE, DEFINITION, NOTE, PROCEDURE_STEP, ROLE, EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT, plus INTERNAL_INTERPRETATION for Stage 8 outputs) with a one-line definition and an example each, and the rule for adding a type. Define the three semantic layers — Source Assertion (what the publisher states), Derived Semantic (classification/entity/relation inferred from the source), Interpretation (organization-specific meaning) — and forbid collapsing them into one text blob. Document the semantic_artifact/v1.1 contract: the shared envelope plus source_evidence[] {segment_id, quote_or_span_ref}, attributes, extraction_method (DETERMINISTIC_RULE, MODEL_EXTRACTION, HUMAN_CURATED, HYBRID), extractor_or_model_ref, interpretation_status (SOURCE_ASSERTION, NORMALIZED_SOURCE_DERIVED, ORGANIZATIONAL_INTERPRETATION) and its acceptance criteria. Define the six authorship labels (publisher-authored, human-curated, rule-derived, model-extracted, model-interpreted, human-approved model interpretation). Specify model-assisted extraction rules: a model call happens only after the use authorization gate allows AI processing for that operation × purpose × target, source content is untrusted data, outputs are schema-constrained with allowed enums, evidence is required, unknowns stay UNKNOWN, and model confidence is not a calibrated truth probability. Close with evidence linkage requirements every artifact must satisfy: the structured anchor shape (element_id, coordinate_type, start/end, excerpt_hash), the offset encoding rule, and the binding of every anchor to the extraction_id and representation content_hash it was resolved against.
agent_hints.input_context: Segments come from SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md and are the only evidence targets. Enum names are indexed in GLOSSARY.md but defined here. Model calls are gated by USE_AUTHORIZATION.md and run inside the TRUST_BOUNDARY.md privilege profile. The envelope is ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md.
agent_hints.validation: Every artifact_type must have a definition and an example. All three semantic layers must be defined with a rule against collapsing them. Every field of semantic_artifact/v1.1 must state type, required and nullable; extraction_method and interpretation_status must list every allowed value. Model-use rules must name the authorization precondition explicitly. Every artifact must require either source evidence or an explicit organization-derived basis. quote_or_span_ref must define its coordinate types, its offset encoding and an excerpt hash, and must state that an unresolvable anchor fails validation.

description.th: Controlled vocabulary เริ่มต้นของ artifact_type และกติกาการเพิ่ม type
description.en: The starter controlled vocabulary of artifact_type and the rule for adding types.

items.text_th: Starter Types — REQUIREMENT, CONTROL_REFERENCE, DEFINITION, NOTE, PROCEDURE_STEP, ROLE, EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT พร้อมนิยามหนึ่งบรรทัดและตัวอย่าง เช่น ctrl_nist_ac_2 เป็น CONTROL_REFERENCE
items.text_en: Starter Types — REQUIREMENT, CONTROL_REFERENCE, DEFINITION, NOTE, PROCEDURE_STEP, ROLE, EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT with a one-line definition and example each, e.g. ctrl_nist_ac_2 is a CONTROL_REFERENCE

items.text_th: Derived Types — INTERNAL_INTERPRETATION สำหรับ artifact ที่ Stage 8 สร้าง; แยกจาก source-derived type เสมอ
items.text_en: Derived Types — INTERNAL_INTERPRETATION for artifacts produced by Stage 8; always separate from source-derived types

items.text_th: Extension Rule — เพิ่ม type ได้เมื่อมี segment_type_hint จาก SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md ที่ map ไม่ได้ และต้องลงทะเบียนใน Enumeration Registry ของ GLOSSARY.md ก่อนใช้
items.text_en: Extension Rule — a type may be added when a SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md segment_type_hint cannot be mapped, and it must be registered in the GLOSSARY.md Enumeration Registry before use

items.text_th: Family Fit — vocabulary ตั้งต้นชุดนี้มีรูปร่างแบบเอกสาร normative; family อื่น (API documentation, dataset/spreadsheet, web content) ที่ segment ไม่เข้ากับ type ใดเลย ต้องเพิ่ม type ผ่าน Extension Rule ข้างต้น ห้ามยัดลง REQUIREMENT หรือ NOTE ให้พอผ่าน — ส่วน capability ที่ family นั้นไม่ใช้เลยประกาศ NOT_APPLICABLE ใน capability profile ของ SOURCE_CATALOG.md
items.text_en: Family Fit — this starter vocabulary is shaped like a normative document; another family (API documentation, dataset/spreadsheet, web content) whose segments fit no type must add one through the Extension Rule above rather than forcing them into REQUIREMENT or NOTE — and a capability that family never uses is declared NOT_APPLICABLE in its SOURCE_CATALOG.md capability profile

description.th: Source Assertion / Derived Semantic / Interpretation — ห้ามยุบเป็นชั้นเดียว
description.en: Source Assertion / Derived Semantic / Interpretation — never collapsed into one.

items.text_th: Source Assertion Layer — สิ่งที่ source/publisher ระบุจริง; ไม่ใช่การรับรองว่าเป็นความจริง ตาม boundary pair source assertion ≠ ground truth ใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Source Assertion Layer — what the source/publisher actually states; not an endorsement of truth, per the GLOSSARY.md boundary pair source assertion ≠ ground truth

items.text_th: Derived Semantic Layer — classification, entity, relation ที่เครื่อง infer จาก source โดยยังมี evidence กลับต้นฉบับ
items.text_en: Derived Semantic Layer — classification, entity and relation inferred from the source while retaining evidence back to it

items.text_th: Interpretation Layer — organization-specific meaning / implementation mapping ที่สร้างเฉพาะผ่าน CONTEXTUALIZATION_SPEC.md และแสดงเป็นชั้นแยกเสมอ
items.text_en: Interpretation Layer — organization-specific meaning / implementation mapping created only through CONTEXTUALIZATION_SPEC.md and always shown as a separate layer

description.th: semantic_artifact/v1.1 — envelope + semantic payload + acceptance criteria
description.en: semantic_artifact/v1.1 — envelope + semantic payload + acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Envelope Part — field ทั้งหมดของ source_artifact_envelope/v1.2 จาก ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md รวม use_authorization_ref และ trust_classification
items.text_en: Envelope Part — every field of source_artifact_envelope/v1.2 from ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md including use_authorization_ref and trust_classification

items.text_th: Semantic Payload — source_evidence[] {segment_id, quote_or_span_ref}, attributes (object), extraction_method ∈ {DETERMINISTIC_RULE, MODEL_EXTRACTION, HUMAN_CURATED, HYBRID}, extractor_or_model_ref (nullable), interpretation_status ∈ {SOURCE_ASSERTION, NORMALIZED_SOURCE_DERIVED, ORGANIZATIONAL_INTERPRETATION}; enum ทั้งสอง index ใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Semantic Payload — source_evidence[] {segment_id, quote_or_span_ref}, attributes (object), extraction_method ∈ {DETERMINISTIC_RULE, MODEL_EXTRACTION, HUMAN_CURATED, HYBRID}, extractor_or_model_ref (nullable), interpretation_status ∈ {SOURCE_ASSERTION, NORMALIZED_SOURCE_DERIVED, ORGANIZATIONAL_INTERPRETATION}; both enums indexed in GLOSSARY.md

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — SOURCE_ASSERTION คือ wording ของ publisher ไม่ใช่ paraphrase; NORMALIZED_SOURCE_DERIVED มี controlled-vocabulary mapping แต่ยังมี evidence; ORGANIZATIONAL_INTERPRETATION แยกชัดและไม่ถูกแสดงเป็น wording ของ publisher; field ที่ไม่รู้คงเป็น unknown
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — SOURCE_ASSERTION is publisher wording, not a paraphrase; NORMALIZED_SOURCE_DERIVED carries controlled-vocabulary mapping but retains evidence; ORGANIZATIONAL_INTERPRETATION is visibly separate and never presented as publisher wording; unknown fields stay unknown

description.th: ใครหรืออะไรสร้าง assertion — label ที่ช่วย downstream กำหนด review policy
description.en: Who or what produced the assertion — labels that let downstream set review policy.

items.text_th: Six Authorship Labels — Publisher-authored, Human-curated, Rule-derived, Model-extracted, Model-interpreted, Human-approved model interpretation
items.text_en: Six Authorship Labels — Publisher-authored, Human-curated, Rule-derived, Model-extracted, Model-interpreted, Human-approved model interpretation

items.text_th: Mapping to Fields — label เกิดจาก extraction_method × interpretation_status × approval_status; ห้ามเดา authorship จาก text
items.text_en: Mapping to Fields — the label derives from extraction_method × interpretation_status × approval_status; authorship is never guessed from text

items.text_th: PROV Alignment — ผู้สร้าง/ผู้รับผิดชอบ activity เป็น prov:Agent ตามที่ PROVENANCE_MODEL.md กำหนด; ชื่อ label ใช้ตาม GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: PROV Alignment — the creator/responsible party of an activity is a prov:Agent as PROVENANCE_MODEL.md defines; label names follow GLOSSARY.md

description.th: เมื่อไหร่และอย่างไรที่ LLM ใช้ได้ใน Stage 4
description.en: When and how an LLM may be used in Stage 4.

items.text_th: Gate Precondition — model call เกิดได้เฉพาะเมื่อ decision ของ AI_PROCESSING × purpose × target ใน USE_AUTHORIZATION.md เป็น ALLOW หรือ CONDITIONAL ที่เงื่อนไขครบ เช่น external LLM ถูก DENY สำหรับ source ที่เป็น CONFIDENTIAL
items.text_en: Gate Precondition — a model call happens only when the AI_PROCESSING × purpose × target decision in USE_AUTHORIZATION.md is ALLOW or CONDITIONAL with all conditions met, e.g. external LLM is DENY for a CONFIDENTIAL source

items.text_th: Untrusted Input — source content เป็น data; extractor รันโดยไม่มี secrets/side-effect tools/connectors ตาม TRUST_BOUNDARY.md; output ถูก constrain ด้วย schema, allowed enum, evidence requirement, no-invention rule
items.text_en: Untrusted Input — source content is data; the extractor runs without secrets/side-effect tools/connectors per TRUST_BOUNDARY.md; output is constrained by schema, allowed enums, evidence requirement and the no-invention rule

items.text_th: Suitable Tasks and Limits — classification, entity/relation extraction, modality identification, vocabulary mapping ผ่าน template ใน PROMPT_SPEC.md; model confidence ไม่ใช่ calibrated probability จนกว่าจะ define/evaluate แยก
items.text_en: Suitable Tasks and Limits — classification, entity/relation extraction, modality identification and vocabulary mapping via PROMPT_SPEC.md templates; model confidence is not a calibrated probability until defined/evaluated separately

description.th: ทุก semantic claim ต้อง trace กลับ span หรือระบุชัดว่าเป็น interpretation
description.en: Every semantic claim traces to a span or is explicitly marked as interpretation.

items.text_th: Evidence Anchor — source_evidence[] ชี้ไปที่ segment_id ของ SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md ด้วย quote_or_span_ref ที่มีโครงสร้าง {element_id, coordinate_type ∈ CHAR_OFFSET / TOKEN_OFFSET / TABLE_CELL / PAGE_BBOX / CSS_SELECTOR / XPATH, start, end, excerpt_hash} เช่น el_nist53r5_0412:0-22; offset นับเป็น UTF-8 codepoint บน verbatim_text ที่ EXTRACTION_SPEC.md เก็บไว้ ไม่ใช่บน byte หรือบน text ที่ normalize แล้ว
items.text_en: Evidence Anchor — source_evidence[] points to a SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md segment_id with a structured quote_or_span_ref {element_id, coordinate_type ∈ CHAR_OFFSET / TOKEN_OFFSET / TABLE_CELL / PAGE_BBOX / CSS_SELECTOR / XPATH, start, end, excerpt_hash}, e.g. el_nist53r5_0412:0-22; offsets count UTF-8 codepoints over the verbatim_text stored by EXTRACTION_SPEC.md — never bytes, and never normalized text

items.text_th: Anchor Binding — anchor ผูกกับ extraction_id + content_hash ของ representation ที่อ่านจริง; ถ้า re-extract ด้วย parser/OCR version ใหม่ anchor เดิมถือว่ายังไม่ valid จนกว่าจะ re-resolve และ excerpt_hash ตรง — anchor ที่ resolve ไม่ได้คือ validation FAIL ไม่ใช่ warning ตาม VALIDATION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Anchor Binding — an anchor is bound to the extraction_id and the content_hash of the representation actually read; after a re-extraction with a new parser or OCR version the old anchor is not valid until it is re-resolved and its excerpt_hash matches — an anchor that does not resolve is a validation FAIL, not a warning, per VALIDATION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: No Invention — ห้ามสร้าง page, clause, identifier, date, actor, threshold ที่ไม่มีใน segment; ค่าที่หาไม่พบเป็น UNKNOWN หรือ null ตาม schema
items.text_en: No Invention — never fabricate a page, clause, identifier, date, actor or threshold absent from the segment; missing values become UNKNOWN or null per schema

items.text_th: Verification — Source Span Validation ใน VALIDATION_SPEC.md ตรวจว่า span มีจริงและ quote ตรงกับ verbatim_content
items.text_en: Verification — Source Span Validation in VALIDATION_SPEC.md checks that the span exists and the quote matches verbatim_content

description.th: Contract ของ Stage 5 — map semantic artifact เข้า canonical schema/vocabulary โดยรักษา original value: source profiles, requirement modality mapping, source_normalization/v2.0 และการจัดการ cross-reference ที่ resolve ไม่ได้
description.en: The Stage 5 contract — mapping semantic artifacts to canonical schemas/vocabulary while retaining original values: source profiles, requirement modality mapping, source_normalization/v2.0 and unresolved cross-reference handling.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md defining how semantic artifacts from different sources speak one canonical language without losing their original wording. State the principle: normalize to compare, never rewrite the original until source identity is lost — original_value and normalized_value always coexist with a mapping_ref. Define the canonical schemas in use (at least standard_control/v1.2 with control_id, framework, base_reference, edition, source_identifier, source_title, canonical_topic) and how new schemas are versioned. Define source profiles (ISO_DIRECTIVES, LEGAL_STATUTE, CONTRACT, INTERNAL_POLICY, NIST_GUIDANCE, VENDOR_DOCUMENTATION) as the unit that owns drafting-convention mappings. Document requirement modality: the canonical labels (REQUIREMENT, RECOMMENDATION, PERMISSION, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY_CAPABILITY, DESCRIPTIVE, EXTERNAL_CONSTRAINT, UNKNOWN) and the rule that mapping goes through a source-specific profile, never a universal dictionary — for ISO drafting conventions shall→REQUIREMENT, should→RECOMMENDATION, may→PERMISSION, can→POSSIBILITY_CAPABILITY and must→EXTERNAL_CONSTRAINT (not a synonym of shall); ambiguous forms stay UNKNOWN and go to review. Document the source_normalization/v2.0 contract: normalized_artifact_id, source_artifact_id, schema_ref, source_profile_ref, fields, mappings[] {field, original_value, normalized_value, mapping_ref, mapping_status ∈ VERIFIED / PROPOSED / UNKNOWN / UNRESOLVED / NOT_APPLICABLE} and acceptance criteria, stating that NOT_APPLICABLE is valid only where the SOURCE_CATALOG.md capability profile switched modality mapping off and that UNKNOWN keeps its own meaning of an ambiguous wording. Close with cross-reference handling: keep table coordinates and reference targets; unresolved targets are marked, never invented.
agent_hints.input_context: Input artifacts follow SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md and carry the ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md envelope. For modality vocabulary and the ISO verbal-forms convention consult references/iso-house-style-verbal-forms.md (paraphrased summary — never copy licensed standard text). Canonical labels are indexed in GLOSSARY.md.
agent_hints.validation: Every canonical schema must have a schema_version and a field list. Every source profile must name its drafting convention and at least one mapping rule. All eight modality labels must be listed, and the must ≠ shall rule must be explicit for the ISO profile. Every field of source_normalization/v2.0 must state type, required and nullable. Every mapping must retain original_value alongside normalized_value. mapping_status must list all five values and separate NOT_APPLICABLE from UNKNOWN by naming the capability profile as the only source of NOT_APPLICABLE. Unresolved cross-reference handling must be specified as a status, not a guess.

description.th: Normalize เพื่อ compare ได้ โดยไม่ทำให้ต้นฉบับหาย
description.en: Normalize to make things comparable without losing the original.

items.text_th: Coexistence Rule — original_value + normalized_value + mapping_ref อยู่คู่กันเสมอ เช่น title_original "Management of technical vulnerabilities" กับ canonical_topic TECHNICAL_VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT
items.text_en: Coexistence Rule — original_value + normalized_value + mapping_ref always coexist, e.g. title_original "Management of technical vulnerabilities" with canonical_topic TECHNICAL_VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT

items.text_th: Layer Discipline — normalization ทำงานบน Derived Semantic Layer ของ SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md; ไม่แตะ verbatim และไม่เพิ่ม interpretation
items.text_en: Layer Discipline — normalization operates on the SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md Derived Semantic Layer; it never touches verbatim text or adds interpretation

items.text_th: Vocabulary Authority — canonical label ทุกตัว index ใน GLOSSARY.md; เอกสารนี้เป็นเจ้าของค่าของ modality labels และ source profiles
items.text_en: Vocabulary Authority — every canonical label is indexed in GLOSSARY.md; this document owns the values of modality labels and source profiles

description.th: Schema กลางที่ normalized artifact ต้องตรง พร้อม version
description.en: Canonical schemas normalized artifacts must match, with versions.

items.text_th: standard_control/v1.2 — control_id, framework, base_reference, edition, source_identifier, source_title, canonical_topic เช่น ctrl_nist_ac_2 / NIST_SP_800_53 / AC-2 / ACCOUNT_MANAGEMENT
items.text_en: standard_control/v1.2 — control_id, framework, base_reference, edition, source_identifier, source_title, canonical_topic e.g. ctrl_nist_ac_2 / NIST_SP_800_53 / AC-2 / ACCOUNT_MANAGEMENT

items.text_th: Schema per Artifact Type — artifact_type ใน SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md แต่ละตัวมี canonical schema อย่างน้อยหนึ่งตัว (เช่น requirement, definition) และประกาศ schema_version
items.text_en: Schema per Artifact Type — each SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md artifact_type has at least one canonical schema (e.g. requirement, definition) declaring a schema_version

items.text_th: Implementation Handoff — schema เหล่านี้ถูกแปลงเป็น JSON Schema/Pydantic ใน SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md; การเพิ่ม field = bump schema_version
items.text_en: Implementation Handoff — these schemas become JSON Schema/Pydantic in SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md; adding a field means bumping schema_version

description.th: หน่วยที่เป็นเจ้าของ drafting-convention mapping ต่อ source family
description.en: The unit that owns drafting-convention mappings per source family.

items.text_th: Profile Set — ISO_DIRECTIVES, LEGAL_STATUTE, CONTRACT, INTERNAL_POLICY, NIST_GUIDANCE, VENDOR_DOCUMENTATION พร้อม version เช่น NIST_GUIDANCE/v1
items.text_en: Profile Set — ISO_DIRECTIVES, LEGAL_STATUTE, CONTRACT, INTERNAL_POLICY, NIST_GUIDANCE, VENDOR_DOCUMENTATION with a version, e.g. NIST_GUIDANCE/v1

items.text_th: Profile Assignment — ทุก source ใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md ได้ profile เดียวจาก publisher_type/document_class; source ที่ capability profile ประกาศ modality_mapping: NOT_APPLICABLE ไม่มี source_profile_ref (null) และ mapping ทั้งชุดเป็น NOT_APPLICABLE — ส่วน source ที่ capability ใช้แต่ยังไม่ได้เลือก profile ถือเป็น configuration error ไม่ใช่ UNKNOWN
items.text_en: Profile Assignment — every SOURCE_CATALOG.md source is assigned one profile from publisher_type/document_class; a source whose capability profile declares modality_mapping: NOT_APPLICABLE has source_profile_ref null and carries NOT_APPLICABLE mappings, while a source where the capability applies but no profile was chosen is a configuration error, not UNKNOWN

items.text_th: Profile Contents — mapping rules (original form → canonical label), mapping_ref naming, และ owner; ชื่อ profile ลงทะเบียนใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Profile Contents — mapping rules (original form → canonical label), mapping_ref naming, and owner; profile names are registered in GLOSSARY.md

description.th: Canonical modality labels และกติกา source-profile-first
description.en: Canonical modality labels and the source-profile-first rule.

items.text_th: Canonical Labels — REQUIREMENT, RECOMMENDATION, PERMISSION, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY_CAPABILITY, DESCRIPTIVE, EXTERNAL_CONSTRAINT, UNKNOWN (index ใน GLOSSARY.md)
items.text_en: Canonical Labels — REQUIREMENT, RECOMMENDATION, PERMISSION, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY_CAPABILITY, DESCRIPTIVE, EXTERNAL_CONSTRAINT, UNKNOWN (indexed in GLOSSARY.md)

items.text_th: ISO_DIRECTIVES Profile — shall → REQUIREMENT, should → RECOMMENDATION, may → PERMISSION, can → POSSIBILITY_CAPABILITY, must → EXTERNAL_CONSTRAINT (ไม่ใช่ synonym ของ shall); profile อื่น เช่น NIST_GUIDANCE map "imperative control statement" → REQUIREMENT
items.text_en: ISO_DIRECTIVES Profile — shall → REQUIREMENT, should → RECOMMENDATION, may → PERMISSION, can → POSSIBILITY_CAPABILITY, must → EXTERNAL_CONSTRAINT (not a synonym of shall); other profiles e.g. NIST_GUIDANCE map "imperative control statement" → REQUIREMENT

items.text_th: Uncertainty Guardrail — ห้ามใช้ universal dictionary; ถ้าไม่มั่นใจให้เก็บ original wording + UNKNOWN แล้วส่ง review; modality เป็น derived attribute ของ artifact ใน SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md ไม่ใช่ applicability
items.text_en: Uncertainty Guardrail — never use a universal dictionary; when unsure keep the original wording + UNKNOWN and route to review; UNKNOWN means the capability applies but the wording is ambiguous, NOT_APPLICABLE means the capability profile switched modality mapping off for this family — the two are never interchangeable per GLOSSARY.md; modality is a derived attribute of the SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md artifact, not applicability

description.th: source_normalization/v2.0 — field และ acceptance criteria
description.en: source_normalization/v2.0 — fields and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Contract Fields — normalized_artifact_id, source_artifact_id, schema_ref, source_profile_ref (nullable), fields (object), mappings[] {field, original_value, normalized_value, mapping_ref, mapping_status}; ห่อด้วย envelope และ activity NORMALIZE ตาม ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md
items.text_en: Contract Fields — normalized_artifact_id, source_artifact_id, schema_ref, source_profile_ref (nullable), fields (object), mappings[] {field, original_value, normalized_value, mapping_ref, mapping_status}; wrapped in the envelope with activity NORMALIZE per ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md

items.text_th: mapping_status — VERIFIED, PROPOSED, UNKNOWN, UNRESOLVED, NOT_APPLICABLE; มีเพียง VERIFIED ที่ผ่านไป publish ได้โดยไม่ต้อง review และ NOT_APPLICABLE ใช้ได้เฉพาะเมื่อ capability profile ใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md ประกาศไว้
items.text_en: mapping_status — VERIFIED, PROPOSED, UNKNOWN, UNRESOLVED, NOT_APPLICABLE; only VERIFIED passes to publish without review, and NOT_APPLICABLE is valid only where the SOURCE_CATALOG.md capability profile declared it

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — original value กู้คืนได้; canonical value ใช้ schema/vocabulary version ที่ประกาศ; ใช้ drafting convention ของ source; ambiguous modality เป็น UNKNOWN; provenance ไม่เปลี่ยน — ตรวจใน Normalization Integrity ของ VALIDATION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — original values recoverable; canonical values use a declared schema/vocabulary version; source drafting conventions applied; ambiguous modality stays UNKNOWN; provenance unchanged — checked in VALIDATION_SPEC.md Normalization Integrity

description.th: ตาราง cross-reference และ target ที่ resolve ไม่ได้ — mark ไม่ invent
description.en: Table cross-references and unresolvable targets — mark, never invent.

items.text_th: Cross-Reference Record — {from_artifact_id, relation เช่น SEE_ALSO / DEPENDS_ON / SUPERSEDES, target_source_ref} สร้างจาก LINK / FIGURE_REF ที่ EXTRACTION_SPEC.md รักษาไว้
items.text_en: Cross-Reference Record — {from_artifact_id, relation e.g. SEE_ALSO / DEPENDS_ON / SUPERSEDES, target_source_ref} built from LINK / FIGURE_REF preserved by EXTRACTION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Unresolved Handling — target ที่ resolve เป็น artifact ไม่ได้ mark resolution_status UNRESOLVED พร้อม original reference text; ห้าม invent target
items.text_en: Unresolved Handling — a target that cannot resolve to an artifact is marked resolution_status UNRESOLVED with the original reference text; never invent a target

items.text_th: Table Semantics — row/column headers และ cell coordinates กลายเป็น attributes ของ artifact ใน SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md โดยเก็บ table identity เดิม
items.text_en: Table Semantics — row/column headers and cell coordinates become attributes of the SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md artifact while keeping the original table identity

description.th: Lineage ข้าม stage ตั้งแต่ acquisition ถึง publish, การ align กับ W3C PROV (Entity / Activity / Agent), authority metadata แบบ descriptive และ contract source_governance/v1.1 — ตอบว่า artifact นี้มาจากไหนและ source มีสถานะอะไร โดยไม่ปนกับ relevance หรือ truth
description.en: Cross-stage lineage from acquisition to publish, W3C PROV alignment (Entity / Activity / Agent), descriptive authority metadata, and the source_governance/v1.1 contract — answers where an artifact came from and what status its source holds, without conflating that with relevance or truth.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a PROVENANCE_MODEL.md that makes every published artifact traceable back to the acquired source bytes. Start with the cross-stage lineage chain: provenance is captured from the ACQUIRE activity onward, and Stage 6 consolidates, verifies and enriches it — it never fabricates missing links. Show the chain Acquired Source → Extracted Elements → Segments → Semantic Artifact → Normalized Artifact → Validated Artifact → Published (with the conditional interpretation branch), each hop tied to a transformation_activity id from ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md. Map the model to W3C PROV: sources, segments, artifacts, model weights and prompt configs are prov:Entity; extraction, inference, normalization and publish executions are prov:Activity; humans, running services and software processes are prov:Agent / prov:SoftwareAgent — state explicitly that a model or parser is not blanket-labeled an Agent. Define the authority model as descriptive dimensions (publisher_type, document_class, source_status, annex_status / provision_type, jurisdiction, organizational_scope, document_approval_status) and forbid a single authority or trust score. Write out the Do-Not-Collapse list. Specify the source_governance/v1.1 contract with lineage and source_authority blocks and its acceptance criteria. Define how derived artifacts are superseded, never mutated, when a source version changes. Close with audit and replay requirements: which hashes, frozen artifacts and versioned transforms must persist for the assurance level chosen in CONSTRAINTS.md, and what the external-audit tier adds — append-only provenance events, signed manifests with key_id and rotation history, and the auditor's verification procedure — stating that the MVP tier gives traceability but not tamper evidence.
agent_hints.input_context: Read ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md for the transformation_activity contract and activity_type enum that every lineage hop references, SOURCE_CONTRACT.md for source identity and version fields, and SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md / NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md for the artifacts whose lineage is being consolidated. Consult references/w3c-prov-core-concepts.md for the Entity / Activity / Agent definitions and the relation vocabulary (wasGeneratedBy, used, wasAssociatedWith, wasDerivedFrom).
agent_hints.validation: Every lineage hop must name an activity_type from ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md. PROV mapping must classify model weights and prompt configs as Entity, not Agent. Authority section must contain zero numeric scores. The source_governance/v1.1 contract must list lineage.transformation_chain, lineage.provenance_completeness_status and every source_authority field. Do-Not-Collapse list must contain at least six inequalities. Supersession section must state that derived artifacts of a superseded source version are regenerated, not edited in place. Audit section must separate the traceability tier from the tamper-evident tier and give the tamper-evident tier a concrete verification procedure.

description.th: โซ่ lineage ตั้งแต่ acquired source ถึง published artifact — provenance เริ่มเก็บที่ Stage 1 ไม่ใช่ Stage 6
description.en: The lineage chain from acquired source to published artifact — provenance capture starts at Stage 1, not Stage 6.

items.text_th: Entity Chain — Acquired Source → Extracted Elements → Segments → Semantic Artifact → Normalized Artifact → Validated Artifact → Published Artifact แต่ละ hop ผูกกับ activity_id จาก transformation_activity ใน ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md
items.text_en: Entity Chain — Acquired Source → Extracted Elements → Segments → Semantic Artifact → Normalized Artifact → Validated Artifact → Published Artifact, each hop bound to an activity_id from the transformation_activity in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md

items.text_th: Capture Point — ทุก activity ตั้งแต่ ACQUIRE สร้าง lineage event ทันที Stage 6 ทำหน้าที่ consolidate / verify / enrich เท่านั้น ห้ามสร้าง link ย้อนหลังที่ไม่มีหลักฐาน
items.text_en: Capture Point — every activity from ACQUIRE onward emits a lineage event immediately; Stage 6 only consolidates / verifies / enriches and never fabricates missing links retroactively

items.text_th: Root Anchor — ปลายโซ่ต้องถึง source_id + acquired_representation hash ใน SOURCE_CONTRACT.md เสมอ ไม่หยุดที่ Markdown snapshot หรือ intermediate file
items.text_en: Root Anchor — the chain must always terminate at the source_id + acquired_representation hash in SOURCE_CONTRACT.md, never at a Markdown snapshot or intermediate file

items.text_th: Run Anchor — ทุก activity ถือ run_id ของ source_pipeline_run/v1.0 ที่ ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md นิยาม ทำให้ audit เริ่มจาก run ได้ ไม่ใช่เริ่มจาก publication อย่างเดียว และ run ที่ PARTIAL ตามได้ว่าค้างที่ stage ไหน
items.text_en: Run Anchor — every activity carries the run_id of the source_pipeline_run/v1.0 record defined in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md, so an audit can start from a run and not only from a publication, and a PARTIAL run shows exactly which stage it stopped at

description.th: Map lineage model เข้ากับ W3C PROV แบบ conceptual โดยไม่ต้องใช้ RDF/OWL ตั้งแต่ MVP
description.en: Conceptual mapping of the lineage model onto W3C PROV, without requiring RDF/OWL from the MVP.

items.text_th: Entity / Activity / Agent Mapping — source, segment, artifact, model weights, prompt config = prov:Entity; extraction / inference / normalization / publish execution = prov:Activity; human reviewer, running service, software process = prov:Agent หรือ prov:SoftwareAgent
items.text_en: Entity / Activity / Agent Mapping — source, segment, artifact, model weights, prompt config = prov:Entity; extraction / inference / normalization / publish execution = prov:Activity; human reviewer, running service, software process = prov:Agent or prov:SoftwareAgent

items.text_th: Model-Is-Not-Agent Nuance — ห้าม map model หรือ parser เป็น Agent เหมารวม: weights/executable/config เป็น Entity (หรือ Plan), inference run เป็น Activity, service ที่รับผิดชอบการรันจึงเป็น SoftwareAgent ตาม executor.kind ใน ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md
items.text_en: Model-Is-Not-Agent Nuance — never blanket-map a model or parser to Agent: weights/executable/config are Entity (or Plan), the inference run is an Activity, and the service responsible for the run is the SoftwareAgent per executor.kind in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md

items.text_th: Relation Vocabulary — artifact wasGeneratedBy activity, activity used prior artifact, activity wasAssociatedWith agent, artifact wasDerivedFrom source_or_prior_artifact; semantic artifact ใน SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md ต้อง derive ได้ถึง segment ที่เป็น evidence
items.text_en: Relation Vocabulary — artifact wasGeneratedBy activity, activity used prior artifact, activity wasAssociatedWith agent, artifact wasDerivedFrom source_or_prior_artifact; every semantic artifact in SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md must be derivable down to its evidence segment

description.th: Authority เป็น descriptive dimensions ของ source status — ไม่ใช่ score เดียว และไม่ใช่ relevance
description.en: Authority as descriptive dimensions of source status — never a single score, never relevance.

items.text_th: Descriptive Dimensions — publisher_type (เช่น INTERNATIONAL_STANDARDS_BODY, NATIONAL_STANDARDS_AGENCY, NONPROFIT_COMMUNITY_BODY, REGULATOR, VENDOR, ORGANIZATION_INTERNAL — ค่านิยามที่นี่), document_class, source_status, annex_status / provision_type (เมื่อเกี่ยวข้อง), jurisdiction, organizational_scope, document_approval_status ค่าเริ่มต้นมาจาก source_authority ใน SOURCE_CONTRACT.md
items.text_en: Descriptive Dimensions — publisher_type (e.g. INTERNATIONAL_STANDARDS_BODY, NATIONAL_STANDARDS_AGENCY, NONPROFIT_COMMUNITY_BODY, REGULATOR, VENDOR, ORGANIZATION_INTERNAL — values owned here), document_class, source_status, annex_status / provision_type (where relevant), jurisdiction, organizational_scope, document_approval_status; initial values come from source_authority in SOURCE_CONTRACT.md

items.text_th: No Single Score — ห้ามใช้ field เช่น authority_score: 0.95 หรือ trust_score ถ้ายังไม่มี calibrated measurement model แยกต่างหาก ให้ downstream evaluation สร้าง score เองเมื่อจำเป็น
items.text_en: No Single Score — fields e.g. authority_score: 0.95 or trust_score are forbidden until a separately calibrated measurement model exists; downstream evaluation derives scores when needed

items.text_th: Do-Not-Collapse List — Authority ≠ Relevance, ≠ Confidence, ≠ Applicability, ≠ Freshness, ≠ Truth และ Document Class ≠ normative status ของทุก element ภายใน; นิยามแต่ละคู่ตาม Boundary Pairs ใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Do-Not-Collapse List — Authority ≠ Relevance, ≠ Confidence, ≠ Applicability, ≠ Freshness, ≠ Truth, and Document Class ≠ normative status of every contained element; each pair defined per Boundary Pairs in GLOSSARY.md

description.th: Contract source_governance/v1.1 — lineage block + source_authority block + acceptance criteria
description.en: The source_governance/v1.1 contract — lineage block, source_authority block, and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Lineage Block — artifact_id, lineage.source_id, lineage.transformation_chain (ลำดับ activity_id), lineage.artifact_hash_or_ref, lineage.provenance_completeness_status (COMPLETE / PARTIAL / BROKEN) อ้าง envelope ใน ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md
items.text_en: Lineage Block — artifact_id, lineage.source_id, lineage.transformation_chain (ordered activity_ids), lineage.artifact_hash_or_ref, lineage.provenance_completeness_status (COMPLETE / PARTIAL / BROKEN), referencing the envelope in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md

items.text_th: Source Authority Block — publisher, publisher_type, document_class, source_status, annex_status, provision_type, jurisdiction, document_approval_status ทุก field nullable ห้ามเดาค่าที่ไม่มี
items.text_en: Source Authority Block — publisher, publisher_type, document_class, source_status, annex_status, provision_type, jurisdiction, document_approval_status; every field nullable, never guess absent values

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — provenance events มีตั้งแต่ acquisition; ทุก published artifact trace ถึง acquired content ได้; derived artifact เก็บ transformation lineage; authority เป็น descriptive ไม่ปลอมเป็น relevance/truth; document class ไม่ถูกใช้แทน normative status — ตรวจโดย VALIDATION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — provenance events exist from acquisition onward; every published artifact traces to acquired content; derived artifacts preserve transformation lineage; authority is descriptive and never masquerades as relevance/truth; document class is not conflated with normative status — checked by VALIDATION_SPEC.md

description.th: เมื่อ source ออก version / amendment ใหม่ derived artifact ต้อง regenerate และ supersede อย่างมี lineage ไม่ใช่แก้ทับ
description.en: When a source gains a new version / amendment, derived artifacts are regenerated and superseded with lineage — never edited in place.

items.text_th: Version Trigger — supersedes / superseded_by, amended_by, corrected_by ใน document_identity ของ SOURCE_CONTRACT.md เป็นตัวจุด regenerate ของ artifact ทุกตัวที่ wasDerivedFrom source version เดิม
items.text_en: Version Trigger — supersedes / superseded_by, amended_by, corrected_by in the SOURCE_CONTRACT.md document_identity trigger regeneration of every artifact that wasDerivedFrom the prior source version

items.text_th: Regenerate-Not-Mutate — artifact ของ v1 ห้ามถูกแก้ให้ดูเหมือนของ v2; สร้าง artifact ใหม่ที่มี artifact_version ใหม่และ wasDerivedFrom ทั้ง source v2 และ artifact v1 รวม normalized artifact ใน NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md ด้วย
items.text_en: Regenerate-Not-Mutate — a v1 artifact is never edited to look like v2; a new artifact is created with a new artifact_version that wasDerivedFrom both source v2 and artifact v1, including the normalized artifact in NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Supersession Handoff — lifecycle ของ artifact เดิมเปลี่ยนเป็น SUPERSEDED และ publication ใหม่ระบุ supersedes_publication_id ตาม PUBLICATION_SPEC.md history ต้องยัง trace ได้เสมอ
items.text_en: Supersession Handoff — the prior artifact's lifecycle becomes SUPERSEDED and the new publication records supersedes_publication_id per PUBLICATION_SPEC.md; history must remain traceable

description.th: สิ่งที่ต้อง persist เพื่อ audit และ replay ตาม assurance level ที่เลือก
description.en: What must persist for audit and replay at the chosen assurance level.

items.text_th: Assurance Level Binding — ระดับ audit จาก CONSTRAINTS.md กำหนดว่าต้องเก็บ full transformation lineage + frozen artifacts หรือแค่ source_id + span (MVP)
items.text_en: Assurance Level Binding — the audit level from CONSTRAINTS.md decides whether full transformation lineage + frozen artifacts are kept or only source_id + span (MVP)

items.text_th: Nondeterministic Activities — สำหรับ LLM extraction model + prompt + temperature + config ไม่พอสำหรับ exact replay ต้อง persist actual produced artifact พร้อม content_hash ตาม Reproducibility ใน ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md
items.text_en: Nondeterministic Activities — for LLM extraction, model + prompt + temperature + config are insufficient for exact replay; the actual produced artifact must persist with its content_hash per Reproducibility in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md

items.text_th: Audit Request Path — คำขอ audit / replay ดำเนินตาม procedure ใน RUNBOOK.md โดย resolve จาก publication → validation report → activity chain → acquired bytes
items.text_en: Audit Request Path — audit / replay requests follow the RUNBOOK.md procedure, resolving publication → validation report → activity chain → acquired bytes

items.text_th: Tamper-Evident Tier — ที่ assurance level แบบ external audit ของ CONSTRAINTS.md: provenance event เขียนลง storage แบบ append-only, publication manifest ถูก sign และบันทึก {key_id, signed_at, algorithm} พร้อมเก็บประวัติ key rotation ไว้ให้ signature เก่ายัง verify ได้
items.text_en: Tamper-Evident Tier — at the external-audit assurance level in CONSTRAINTS.md: provenance events are written to append-only storage, publication manifests are signed, each signature records {key_id, signed_at, algorithm}, and key rotation history is retained so older signatures stay verifiable

items.text_th: Verification Procedure — auditor ต้อง recompute content_hash ของ artifact, verify signature ของ manifest กับ key_id ที่บันทึกไว้ และตรวจว่า event sequence ไม่มีช่องว่าง; tier MVP ต้องระบุตรง ๆ ว่าให้ traceability แต่ไม่ให้ tamper evidence — ห้ามปล่อยให้เข้าใจผิดว่าเท่ากัน
items.text_en: Verification Procedure — an auditor recomputes the artifact content_hash, verifies the manifest signature against the recorded key_id, and confirms the event sequence has no gap; the MVP tier must state plainly that it provides traceability but not tamper evidence — the two are never presented as equivalent

description.th: Gate ที่ตรวจ structural correctness, lineage integrity, source fidelity, use authorization และ trust boundary ก่อน publish — 11 validation layers, contract source_validation_report/v2.0 และ checklist มิติ A–G
description.en: The gate that checks structural correctness, lineage integrity, source fidelity, use authorization and trust boundary before publication — 11 validation layers, the source_validation_report/v2.0 contract, and the A–G dimension checklist.

suggested_headings: Structural Validation vs Semantic Evaluation vs Task Evaluation

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a VALIDATION_SPEC.md defining the Stage 7 gate. List the 11 validation layers in order — use authorization (rights + data governance + target policy), source trust boundary / privilege isolation, file integrity, extraction coverage, schema, source span, hierarchy, semantic consistency, referential integrity, version / temporal, and human review gate for high risk — and state for each what is checked, by which deterministic rule or reviewer, and which artifact type it applies to. Separate three questions that must never be mixed: structural validation (valid per schema and provenance?), semantic evaluation (classification / interpretation correct?), task evaluation (does using the artifact improve the task?). Specify the source_validation_report/v2.0 contract: validation_report_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, source_id, validated_at, validated_by, status enum PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNINGS / FAIL / REQUIRES_REVIEW, the per-check NOT_APPLICABLE value and the capability_profile_ref that must justify it, the eight checks (use_authorization_validity, trust_boundary_validity, schema_validity, source_traceability, source_span_validity, hierarchy_integrity, normalization_integrity, interpretation_separation) and issues[] pointing to artifact and source locations. Reproduce the A–G dimension checklist (source identity + use authorization, extraction, segmentation, semantic, normalization, governance + security, publication) as decidable check items. Define what happens on FAIL and REQUIRES_REVIEW — quarantine or review, never normal publication — and how the report links to latest_validation_report_id on the envelope. End with the deterministic-first rule: anything checkable by code or schema runs before any LLM judge.
agent_hints.input_context: Validates artifacts defined in SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md and NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md against the envelope in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md, the lineage in PROVENANCE_MODEL.md, the decisions in USE_AUTHORIZATION.md and the privilege profile in TRUST_BOUNDARY.md. Every check must be traceable to one of those upstream contracts.
agent_hints.validation: Exactly 11 validation layers listed in order, each naming a checker (rule / schema / reviewer). Status enum must be exactly PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, FAIL, REQUIRES_REVIEW. All eight check keys of source_validation_report/v2.0 must be present. Dimension checklist must cover A through G. Gate semantics must state that FAIL and REQUIRES_REVIEW cannot enter normal publication, that NOT_APPLICABLE is valid only where the capability profile declared it, and that NOT_APPLICABLE never stands in for FAIL. The validation report must be declared a separate immutable artifact, not embedded in semantic attributes.

description.th: 11 ชั้นของการตรวจ เรียงจาก authorization และ trust ไปจนถึง human review
description.en: The 11 validation layers, ordered from authorization and trust through to human review.

items.text_th: Layer Order — (1) Use Authorization (rights + data governance + target policy) ตาม USE_AUTHORIZATION.md, (2) Source Trust Boundary / Privilege Isolation ตาม TRUST_BOUNDARY.md, (3) File Integrity, (4) Extraction Coverage, (5) Schema, (6) Source Span, (7) Hierarchy, (8) Semantic Consistency, (9) Referential Integrity, (10) Version / Temporal, (11) Human Review Gate เมื่อ risk สูง
items.text_en: Layer Order — (1) Use Authorization (rights + data governance + target policy) per USE_AUTHORIZATION.md, (2) Source Trust Boundary / Privilege Isolation per TRUST_BOUNDARY.md, (3) File Integrity, (4) Extraction Coverage, (5) Schema, (6) Source Span, (7) Hierarchy, (8) Semantic Consistency, (9) Referential Integrity, (10) Version / Temporal, (11) Human Review Gate when risk is high

items.text_th: Checker per Layer — แต่ละ layer ระบุว่าถูกตรวจด้วย deterministic rule, JSON Schema, referential lookup หรือ human reviewer และใช้กับ artifact type ไหน (source record, extraction, segment, semantic, normalized, derived); layer ที่ capability profile ใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md ปิดไว้รายงาน NOT_APPLICABLE ไม่ใช่ PASS
items.text_en: Checker per Layer — each layer names whether it is checked by deterministic rule, JSON Schema, referential lookup or human reviewer, and which artifact types it applies to (source record, extraction, segment, semantic, normalized, derived); a layer switched off by the capability profile in SOURCE_CATALOG.md reports NOT_APPLICABLE, never PASS

items.text_th: Blocking Layers — ชั้น 1–2 block ทันทีเมื่อไม่ผ่าน (ไม่มี warning) เพราะ AI processing ที่ไม่ได้รับอนุญาตหรือ extractor ที่ถือ secrets ถือเป็น policy failure ไม่ใช่ quality issue
items.text_en: Blocking Layers — layers 1–2 block immediately on failure (no warning tier) because unauthorized AI processing or an extractor holding secrets is a policy failure, not a quality issue

sections.heading: Structural Validation vs Semantic Evaluation vs Task Evaluation

description.th: สามคำถามที่ห้ามปนกัน — valid ตาม contract? ถูกความหมาย? ใช้แล้ว task ดีขึ้น?
description.en: Three questions that must never be mixed — valid per contract? semantically correct? does the task improve?

items.text_th: Structural Validation — "artifact valid ตาม schema และ provenance ไหม?" ตรวจใน Stage 7 ด้วย code ทั้งหมด ผลเป็น status ใน validation report
items.text_en: Structural Validation — "is the artifact valid per schema and provenance?" — checked entirely by code in Stage 7, result recorded as the validation report status

items.text_th: Semantic Evaluation — "classification / interpretation ถูกความหมายไหม?" ใช้ golden set และ review กับ artifact_type และ interpretation_status ใน SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md ผลอยู่ใน TEST_PLAN.md ไม่ใช่ใน report status
items.text_en: Semantic Evaluation — "is the classification / interpretation semantically right?" — uses golden sets and review against artifact_type and interpretation_status in SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md; results live in TEST_PLAN.md, not in the report status

items.text_th: Task Evaluation — "เอา artifact ไปใช้แล้ว outcome ดีไหม?" เป็น downstream measurement ห้ามเขียนกลับเป็น field ของ source artifact
items.text_en: Task Evaluation — "does using the artifact improve the task outcome?" — a downstream measurement that must never be written back as a field on the source artifact

description.th: Contract source_validation_report/v2.0 — artifact แยกที่ immutable และผูกกับ envelope ผ่าน latest_validation_report_id
description.en: The source_validation_report/v2.0 contract — a separate immutable artifact linked to the envelope via latest_validation_report_id.

items.text_th: Identity Fields — validation_report_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, source_id, validated_at, validated_by {kind, name, version} เช่น {SOFTWARE_AGENT, sourcevault_validator, 1.0.0}
items.text_en: Identity Fields — validation_report_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, source_id, validated_at, validated_by {kind, name, version}, e.g. {SOFTWARE_AGENT, sourcevault_validator, 1.0.0}

items.text_th: Status and Checks — status ∈ {PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, FAIL, REQUIRES_REVIEW}; ทุก check มีค่า NOT_APPLICABLE ได้ และต้องระบุ capability_profile_ref ที่เป็นเหตุผลกำกับ; checks 8 ตัว: use_authorization_validity, trust_boundary_validity, schema_validity, source_traceability, source_span_validity, hierarchy_integrity, normalization_integrity, interpretation_separation; source_traceability ตรวจ lineage ตาม PROVENANCE_MODEL.md; source_span_validity re-resolve evidence anchor แล้วเทียบ excerpt_hash ตาม SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md; use_authorization_validity ต้องเจอ record ที่ ACTIVE และยังไม่เลย expires_at ด้วย และต้อง fail เมื่อ source ที่ contains_personal_data ผ่าน AI processing โดยไม่มี source_redaction/v1.0 ที่ตรงกับ representation ที่อ่าน
items.text_en: Status and Checks — status ∈ {PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, FAIL, REQUIRES_REVIEW}; every check value may also be NOT_APPLICABLE, which must name the capability_profile_ref that justifies it; eight checks: use_authorization_validity, trust_boundary_validity, schema_validity, source_traceability, source_span_validity, hierarchy_integrity, normalization_integrity, interpretation_separation; source_traceability verifies lineage per PROVENANCE_MODEL.md; source_span_validity re-resolves each evidence anchor and compares its excerpt_hash per SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md; use_authorization_validity additionally requires the source_use_authorization record to be ACTIVE and not past expires_at, and fails when a source with contains_personal_data ran AI processing without a source_redaction/v1.0 record matching the representation that was read

items.text_th: Issues and Linkage — issues[] แต่ละรายการชี้ artifact location และ source location เมื่อทำได้; report เป็น immutable/versioned artifact แยก ส่วน envelope ใน ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md ถือแค่ latest_validation_report_id ห้ามซ่อน error ไว้ใน semantic attributes
items.text_en: Issues and Linkage — each issues[] entry points to an artifact location and a source location where possible; the report is a separate immutable/versioned artifact while the envelope in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md holds only latest_validation_report_id — errors are never hidden inside semantic attributes

description.th: Checklist มิติ A–G ที่แปลงเป็น check item ตัดสินได้ ต่อ stage doc ที่เป็นเจ้าของ
description.en: The A–G dimension checklist rendered as decidable check items, mapped to the owning stage document.

items.text_th: A–C Source, Extraction, Segmentation — source_id stable, hash บันทึกและไม่ใช้เป็น authenticity proof, base version/modifiers ระบุหรือ UNKNOWN (SOURCE_CONTRACT.md); headings/tables/location refs ครบ, OCR แยกจาก native text (EXTRACTION_SPEC.md); ไม่มี text หาย, hierarchy reconstructable (SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: A–C Source, Extraction, Segmentation — source_id stable, hash recorded and not used as authenticity proof, base version/modifiers explicit or UNKNOWN (SOURCE_CONTRACT.md); headings/tables/location refs preserved, OCR distinguishable from native text (EXTRACTION_SPEC.md); no silent text loss, hierarchy reconstructable (SEGMENTATION_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: D–E Semantic, Normalization — artifact_type valid, source evidence มี, model ไม่ invent ค่าที่ไม่รู้, source-derived vs interpreted ระบุชัด (SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md); schema version ประกาศ, original value คงอยู่, mapping rule มี version (NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: D–E Semantic, Normalization — artifact_type valid, source evidence present, model does not invent unknown data, source-derived vs interpreted explicit (SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md); canonical schema version declared, original value retained, mapping rule versioned (NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: F–G Governance + Security, Publication — lineage ครบตั้งแต่ acquisition, PROV แยก Entity/Activity/Agent, authority ไม่ใช่ score, extractor ไม่มี side-effect tools/secrets (PROVENANCE_MODEL.md); validation PASS ตาม policy, approval NOT_REQUIRED/APPROVED, RELEASE_CANDIDATE → PUBLISHED, hash และ supersession บันทึก (PUBLICATION_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: F–G Governance + Security, Publication — lineage complete from acquisition, PROV distinguishes Entity/Activity/Agent, authority is not a score, extractor has no side-effect tools/secrets (PROVENANCE_MODEL.md); validation PASS per policy, approval NOT_REQUIRED/APPROVED, RELEASE_CANDIDATE → PUBLISHED, hash and supersession recorded (PUBLICATION_SPEC.md)

description.th: ผลของแต่ละ status ต่อ lifecycle และ publication — FAIL / REQUIRES_REVIEW ห้ามเข้า normal publication
description.en: What each status means for lifecycle and publication — FAIL / REQUIRES_REVIEW never enter normal publication.

items.text_th: Status Consequences — PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNINGS เข้า publish gate ใน PUBLICATION_SPEC.md ได้; FAIL → QUARANTINED; REQUIRES_REVIEW → review queue โดย lifecycle_status ใน ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md เปลี่ยนตาม
items.text_en: Status Consequences — PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNINGS may enter the publish gate in PUBLICATION_SPEC.md; FAIL → QUARANTINED; REQUIRES_REVIEW → review queue, with lifecycle_status in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md updated accordingly

items.text_th: Warning Policy — เงื่อนไขใดเป็น warning (เช่น OCR confidence ต่ำแต่ span ตรง) เทียบกับ error (span หาย, enum ผิด, hash ไม่ตรง) ต้องเขียนเป็นตาราง ไม่ปล่อยให้ validator ตัดสินเอง
items.text_en: Warning Policy — which conditions are warnings (e.g. low OCR confidence with matching span) versus errors (missing span, invalid enum, hash mismatch) must be tabulated, never left to the validator's discretion

items.text_th: Operational Routing — quarantine, re-extract, human inspect และ review queue ดำเนินตาม Failure Routing Table ใน RUNBOOK.md; ทุก re-run สร้าง validation report ใหม่ ไม่แก้ report เดิม
items.text_en: Operational Routing — quarantine, re-extract, human inspection and review queues follow the Failure Routing Table in RUNBOOK.md; every re-run produces a new validation report, never edits the old one

items.text_th: NOT_APPLICABLE Discipline — NOT_APPLICABLE ใช้แทน FAIL หรือ REQUIRES_REVIEW ไม่ได้: ใช้ได้เฉพาะเมื่อ capability profile ของ source ประกาศ NOT_APPLICABLE ไว้ล่วงหน้า; check ที่เป็น NOT_APPLICABLE ทั้งที่ profile บอกว่า APPLIES = validation FAIL และ check ที่ APPLIES แต่ไม่มีผลตรวจ = FAIL เช่นกัน — เงียบไม่เท่ากับผ่าน
items.text_en: NOT_APPLICABLE Discipline — NOT_APPLICABLE never substitutes for FAIL or REQUIRES_REVIEW: it is valid only where the source's capability profile declared it in advance; a check reported NOT_APPLICABLE while the profile says APPLIES is itself a validation FAIL, and so is a check the profile marks APPLIES that produced no result — silence is not a pass

description.th: สิ่งที่ตรวจด้วย code/schema ได้ต้องรันก่อน LLM judge เสมอ
description.en: Anything checkable by code or schema runs before any LLM judge.

items.text_th: Deterministic Set — schema, enum, source-span existence + anchor resolution (excerpt_hash ตรง), hash equality, referential integrity, status-dimension separation, authorization evidence, authorization record ที่ ACTIVE และยังไม่เลย expires_at, การมี redaction record สำหรับ source ที่มีข้อมูลส่วนบุคคล — implement เป็น validator ตาม SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md
items.text_en: Deterministic Set — schema, enum, source-span existence and anchor resolution (excerpt_hash match), hash equality, authorization-record validity (ACTIVE and unexpired), redaction presence for personal-data sources, referential integrity, status-dimension separation, authorization evidence — implemented as the validator per SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md

items.text_th: LLM Judge Scope — ใช้เฉพาะ semantic consistency ที่ code ตรวจไม่ได้ และเรียกได้หลัง deterministic set ผ่านแล้วเท่านั้น โดย prompt ต้องเป็น PROMPT-NNN ใน PROMPT_SPEC.md ที่ explain/flag ไม่ตัดสิน publish
items.text_en: LLM Judge Scope — used only for semantic consistency that code cannot check, invoked only after the deterministic set passes, with the prompt registered as a PROMPT-NNN in PROMPT_SPEC.md that explains / flags but never decides publication

items.text_th: Rule Enforcement — deterministic-first เป็น Contract Governance Rule ใน AGENTS.md; CI ต้อง fail ถ้ามี LLM call ก่อน schema validation ใน code path ของ Stage 7
items.text_en: Rule Enforcement — deterministic-first is a Contract Governance Rule in AGENTS.md; CI must fail if any LLM call precedes schema validation in the Stage 7 code path

description.th: Stage 8 แบบ conditional — routing decision SKIP / APPLY / NEEDS_REVIEW, applicability contract และ interpretation contract ที่แยก “สิ่งที่ source บอก” ออกจาก “สิ่งที่องค์กรตัดสินและ operationalize”
description.en: The conditional Stage 8 — the SKIP / APPLY / NEEDS_REVIEW routing decision, the applicability contract and the interpretation contract that keep "what the source says" separate from "what the organization decided and operationalizes".

suggested_headings: Approval and Publication Requirements for Derived Artifacts

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a CONTEXTUALIZATION_SPEC.md for the optional Stage 8 branch. Open by stating which source families in scope need organizational contextualization (standards, regulations, internal policies, control frameworks) and which publish directly after validation (API documentation, research papers, product documentation, reference data). Define the source_contextualization_decision/v1.0 contract — decision_id, source_id, decision ∈ SKIP / APPLY / NEEDS_REVIEW, rationale, derived_artifact_ids — and its three invariants: SKIP publishes source-derived artifacts only and must not smuggle interpretation into source assertions; APPLY routes to typed applicability / interpretation / mapping artifacts; NEEDS_REVIEW blocks normal publication until a governed decision is recorded. Specify source_applicability/v1.1 (applicability_id, source_artifact_id, assessed_scope, decision ∈ APPLICABLE / NOT_APPLICABLE / PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE / NEEDS_REVIEW, determination_basis[], rationale, evidence_refs[], assessor, assessed_at) and source_interpretation/v1.1 (interpretation_id, source_artifact_ids[], applicability_id, interpretation_type ∈ INTERNAL_GUIDANCE / IMPLEMENTATION_MAPPING / CONTROL_MAPPING / PROCEDURE_MAPPING / RISK_INTERPRETATION, statement, owner, approval_status, interpretation_basis[]). Explain the determination-basis rule: applicability follows from risk assessment, obligations and control-determination records, never from scope membership alone — use a short ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A contrast (Annex A is a reference set; the Statement of Applicability records necessary controls and justifications). Close with approval and publication requirements: derived artifacts carry their own envelope identity, interpretation_status ORGANIZATIONAL_INTERPRETATION, an approval_status gate, and separate use-authorization evaluation before publication.
agent_hints.input_context: Runs only on artifacts whose validation report in VALIDATION_SPEC.md is PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS. Derived artifacts reuse the envelope in ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md and the interpretation_status layers in SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md. Source families and roles (SME assessor, governance owner) come from SOURCE_DOMAIN.md.
agent_hints.validation: Decision enum must be exactly SKIP, APPLY, NEEDS_REVIEW with all three invariants stated. Applicability decision enum must be exactly APPLICABLE, NOT_APPLICABLE, PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE, NEEDS_REVIEW. Interpretation type enum must list exactly five values. Every applicability record must require assessed_scope, determination_basis, rationale, assessor and assessed_at. The document must state that applicability never mutates the source artifact and that interpretation is never presented as publisher wording.

description.th: Stage 8 เป็น branch ไม่ใช่ข้อบังคับ — source family ไหนต้อง contextualize และ family ไหน publish ตรงหลัง validation
description.en: Stage 8 is a branch, not a requirement — which source families need contextualization and which publish directly after validation.

items.text_th: Contextualize Families — standard / regulation / internal policy / control framework จาก scope ใน SOURCE_DOMAIN.md มักต้องมี applicability, interpretation หรือ mapping ก่อนใช้
items.text_en: Contextualize Families — standard / regulation / internal policy / control framework from the SOURCE_DOMAIN.md scope usually need applicability, interpretation or mapping before use

items.text_th: Direct-Publish Families — API documentation, research paper, product documentation, reference data publish source-derived artifact ได้ทันทีหลัง validation ตาม publication path ใน ARCHITECTURE.md
items.text_en: Direct-Publish Families — API documentation, research papers, product documentation and reference data publish source-derived artifacts right after validation, per the publication paths in ARCHITECTURE.md

items.text_th: Per-Source Default — routing เริ่มต้นของแต่ละ source อ่านจาก capability profile ใน SOURCE_CATALOG.md (contextualization: APPLIES → APPLY, NOT_APPLICABLE → SKIP) ไม่ใช่เขียนซ้ำเป็นข้อความ; การตัดสินจริงยังบันทึกเป็น contextualization decision เสมอ และ decision ที่ขัดกับ profile ต้องมี rationale ที่บันทึกไว้
items.text_en: Per-Source Default — each source's default routing is read from the SOURCE_CATALOG.md capability profile (contextualization APPLIES → APPLY, NOT_APPLICABLE → SKIP) rather than restated in prose; the actual decision is still always recorded as a contextualization decision, and a decision contradicting the profile needs a recorded rationale

description.th: Contract source_contextualization_decision/v1.0 — typed routing gate ที่แยกจาก derived artifact
description.en: The source_contextualization_decision/v1.0 contract — a typed routing gate separate from the derived artifacts.

items.text_th: Fields — decision_id, source_id, decision ∈ {SKIP, APPLY, NEEDS_REVIEW}, rationale, derived_artifact_ids[]; precondition คือ validation report ใน VALIDATION_SPEC.md เป็น PASS หรือ PASS_WITH_WARNINGS
items.text_en: Fields — decision_id, source_id, decision ∈ {SKIP, APPLY, NEEDS_REVIEW}, rationale, derived_artifact_ids[]; precondition is a PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS validation report in VALIDATION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Three Invariants — SKIP publish เฉพาะ source-derived artifact ห้ามแอบใส่ organizational interpretation ลง source assertion; APPLY route ไป typed Applicability / Interpretation / Mapping; NEEDS_REVIEW block normal publication จนกว่าจะบันทึก governed decision
items.text_en: Three Invariants — SKIP publishes source-derived artifacts only and must not smuggle organizational interpretation into source assertions; APPLY routes to typed Applicability / Interpretation / Mapping artifacts; NEEDS_REVIEW blocks normal publication until a governed decision is recorded

items.text_th: Activity Binding — decision สร้างโดย activity_type CONTEXTUALIZATION_DECIDE และ derived artifact แต่ละตัวมี envelope identity ของตัวเองตาม ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md ห้ามใช้ artifact_id ร่วมกับ source artifact
items.text_en: Activity Binding — the decision is produced by activity_type CONTEXTUALIZATION_DECIDE and every derived artifact carries its own envelope identity per ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.md, never sharing an artifact_id with the source artifact

description.th: Contract source_applicability/v1.1 — คำตัดสินขององค์กรว่า requirement/control นี้เกี่ยวกับ scope ที่ประเมินหรือไม่
description.en: The source_applicability/v1.1 contract — the organization's decision on whether a requirement/control applies to the assessed scope.

items.text_th: Fields — applicability_id, source_artifact_id (ชี้ semantic artifact ใน SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md), assessed_scope {organization, scope}, decision ∈ {APPLICABLE, NOT_APPLICABLE, PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE, NEEDS_REVIEW}, determination_basis[], rationale, evidence_refs[], assessor {type, id}, assessed_at
items.text_en: Fields — applicability_id, source_artifact_id (pointing at a semantic artifact in SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.md), assessed_scope {organization, scope}, decision ∈ {APPLICABLE, NOT_APPLICABLE, PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE, NEEDS_REVIEW}, determination_basis[], rationale, evidence_refs[], assessor {type, id}, assessed_at

items.text_th: Applicability ≠ Source Fact — ห้ามเขียน applicable: true ลงบน source artifact; applicability เป็น record แยกที่มี scope, เวลา และ assessor ตาม Boundary Pairs ใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Applicability ≠ Source Fact — never write applicable: true onto the source artifact; applicability is a separate record with scope, time and assessor, per Boundary Pairs in GLOSSARY.md

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — ไม่ mutate source artifact; rationale และ assessed_scope ระบุชัด; determination_basis ระบุจริงไม่ใช่ infer จาก scope; assessor และเวลาที่ตัดสิน trace ได้
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — never mutates the source artifact; rationale and assessed_scope are explicit; determination_basis is explicit rather than inferred from scope alone; assessor and decision time are traceable

description.th: Contract source_interpretation/v1.1 — วิธีที่องค์กรแปลความและ operationalize โดย label ว่าเป็น organization-derived เสมอ
description.en: The source_interpretation/v1.1 contract — how the organization interprets and operationalizes, always labeled as organization-derived.

items.text_th: Fields — interpretation_id, source_artifact_ids[], applicability_id (nullable), interpretation_type ∈ {INTERNAL_GUIDANCE, IMPLEMENTATION_MAPPING, CONTROL_MAPPING, PROCEDURE_MAPPING, RISK_INTERPRETATION}, statement, owner, approval_status, interpretation_basis[]
items.text_en: Fields — interpretation_id, source_artifact_ids[], applicability_id (nullable), interpretation_type ∈ {INTERNAL_GUIDANCE, IMPLEMENTATION_MAPPING, CONTROL_MAPPING, PROCEDURE_MAPPING, RISK_INTERPRETATION}, statement, owner, approval_status, interpretation_basis[]
